notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/fd11ddd5964275daef4cfc0b0d1c78254a335401.png"]
Happy 3rd Anniversary, Mercenaries!


Mercenaries!


We are excited to celebrate the 3rd anniversary of A.V.A Global with you.


We sincerely thank you for your unwavering support and valuable feedback over the past three years.
Every voice and every moment of participation from our players has been the driving force behind our growth and improvement.



From the very beginning, we embarked on this journey with the goal of creating A.V.A’s unique and special fun, and thanks to your continued support, we were never alone along the way.
The energy to introduce countless updates and new features has always come from the encouragement of our players.



Moving forward, A.V.A Global will continue striving to provide an even more stable and enjoyable experience.
We promise to always give our best, even behind the scenes.



Once again, we extend our heartfelt gratitude to all players who have shared this journey with us over the past three years.



Thank you.



Sincerely,
Your AVA Global Development & Operations Team

notes.title: August Update Note (+Abuse Policy Update)
notes.content:
Mercenaries! 

The August Update has arrived!

This update celebrates the 3rd Anniversary of A.V.A Global with exciting new content, challenges, and powerful gear. Get ready to dive into explosive missions, fresh maps, and exclusive anniversary rewards!


New Demolition Map : NAMSAN
The new demolition map Namsan is set around Seoul’s iconic landmark, Namsan, and is inspired by traditional Korean hanok architecture. It features complex terrain with significant elevation differences and strategically hidden points throughout the urban environment.



The map is designed to support fast-paced combat and dynamic tactical play, with structures that facilitate both attacking and defending. Key strategic elements, such as doors that automatically open when a C4 is planted and rooftops of convenience stores, are positioned to have a decisive impact on the flow of battle.



Players can expect multiple attack and defense routes, allowing for simultaneous breakthroughs, flanking maneuvers, and versatile tactical strategies. Elevation differences and urban obstacles encourage players to think creatively and make strategic use of the environment.



Experience Namsan, the first map to bring a Korean cityscape into A.V.A, and explore the fast-paced, tactical gameplay it offers!

Abuse Policy Update - Custom Channel XP
We have identified cases where players created abnormal rooms in Custom Channels to gain experience points unfairly. After reviewing previous season data, it appears some XP was obtained through unintended methods.

To ensure fair play, a new rule will be applied starting this season:

Any player caught abusing XP gain in this manner will have their Season Ranking reset by default.

The definition of “abnormal behavior” is at the discretion of the game operations team.

Penalty Structure:
[olist]
1st – Warning

2nd – 30-day account suspension

3rd – Permanent ban
[/olist]
We appreciate your understanding and cooperation in maintaining a fair and competitive environment.



Sincerely,

Your AVA Operations Team

notes.title: July Update Note
notes.content:
Mercenaries!

The July Update Is Here!

Get ready for new content and exciting changes!


New Annihilation Map : Anaconda Core
\[What is Core Map?]

Core Map Content offers a fresh take on the strategic and tactical hotspots within existing maps. It reinterprets and reintroduces areas where key engagements typically unfold.

For this iteration, Anaconda: Core, we've modified three crucial combat zones from the original map layout.

Firstly, we've opened up the entrances to the central engagement area, which previously acted as a bridge, allowing for horizontal flanking maneuvers into enemy territory. This changes the combat flow from primarily vertical engagements to now include broader horizontal pushes.

Furthermore, we've reconfigured the pathways into each faction's territory, making them accessible to all teams. This adjustment encourages more dynamic back-line infiltration and allows for the proactive use of defensive positions.

By altering these core structural elements, we aim to deliver more thrilling gameplay, enabling players to secure victory through a wider array of strategies and tactics.

We appreciate your keen interest and participation!

notes.title: Outpost: Level Designer Interview (+ Coupon & Play Event!)
notes.content:
Mercenaries!

Get ready for an exciting new experience in AVA Global—Outpost (Control Mode) is now live and available to play!
This fresh addition brings a whole new dynamic to your battles, with strategic gameplay and new features to keep you on your toes!

Let’s dive into what makes this new addition so special:

Outpost Level Designer Interview

Q1: Can you introduce Outpost (Control Mode) and explain how it works?

★Level Designer★: Sure! Outpost (Control Mode) is a capture and elimination-based mode where two teams fight to control three flag points on the map. At the beginning of each round, the flags are neutral, and both teams will battle to secure them. Once a team captures a flag, they activate both personal and team buffs, which make them stronger for a limited time. If you get kills while the buffs are active, you earn additional bonus points for your team. The team that reaches the target score first wins the round.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/9037a5f136597e47746c493f385ae1a4a3119c36.jpg

Q2: What new features and systems have been added to Control Mode?

★Level Designer★: We’ve introduced a Boost Jump feature that allows players to jump higher than normal, adding new movement opportunities. This makes it easier to cross over into enemy territory or surprise opponents from unexpected angles. The Outpost map is designed with vertical elements to make full use of this mechanic, giving players new strategies to explore.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/5a5ef25f24ac3e2aa00dac72472c1742adbe71d0.jpg
PLAYOUTPOST1
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/bde3508763d9ad62f5502d125f30cffe0df88318.png
Additionally, we’ve added five special skills that players can use to gain an edge in battle. These skills are charged by contributing to flag captures and getting kills. They include:

 SCAN: Detects enemies within 50m in real-time
 Dash Bomb: Teleports and explodes at the destination
 Sniper Pistol: A one-shot pistol that eliminates enemies with precision
 M202: A four-shot rocket launcher
 GM94: A wide-area grenade launcher
(You can use skills with the F key. Secondary slot weapons cannot be used.)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/561a25357b1a702a71fc51f2915bb77a4c26e9d3.jpg


These skills add another layer of strategy, allowing players to tailor their playstyle to their preferred tactics.

Q3: Can you tell us more about the Outpost map and its design?

★Level Designer★: Outpost is designed specifically for Control Mode. The map is structured in a + shape, making it easy to circulate and move between the three control points. Each of the control points offers its own set of challenges and opportunities:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/55bdd2208cc79e3c5edadf8444d8314917841938.jpg
▶ A Flag Control Point Area 
This point is the closest to where the round begins, and it’s an open space, so be prepared for early rushes. The Boost Jump mechanic can be used here to gain aerial dominance.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/ec2000bef2c37dff4530075cb0297f4bb1f1ff7d.jpg
▶ B Flag Control Point Area 
A bit farther out, B is the key to controlling the map. It’s designed for sniper battles and close-quarters combat, with a sniper’s line of sight leading to the control point.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/71f5a5bfb8bd8b7a10d839688f8453ea821adce1.jpg
▶ C Flag Control Point Area 
The only indoor control point, C is perfect for using Boost Jump and offers great potential for comebacks. The multiple entry points make it a high-risk, high-reward area to fight for.

Q4: Do you have any final thoughts for players gearing up to play Outpost (Control Mode)?


★Level Designer★: I hope everyone enjoys the new Outpost map and Control Mode! The updated mechanics, including the Boost Jump and the new skill system, are designed to keep the gameplay fresh and engaging. Be sure to experiment with the new movement options and skills—there’s a lot of potential for creative plays. Good luck, and we can’t wait to see you dominate the battlefield!

notes.title: Control Mode Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Mercenaries!

Get ready for some exciting updates coming soon to A.V.A! We're giving you a quick preview of Control Mode and its exclusive Outpost Map.

Control - Classic Game Mode Returns

The beloved flag capturing and zone control mode that many mercenaries have enjoyed is making its comeback. Enhanced with upgraded boost jump abilities that change how you navigate maps, plus 5 special skills that can turn the tide of battle. Experience more intense combat with real-time enemy scanning, teleportation attacks, and powerful special weapons.

Outpost - Dedicated Control Map

The Outpost map has been specifically designed for this mode. It features a cross-shaped layout with 3 strategic capture points, each offering different tactical challenges:


 Point A - An outdoor zone perfect for early rushes, but watch the skies!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/55bdd2208cc79e3c5edadf8444d8314917841938.jpg

 Point B - A distant outpost ideal for long-range engagements
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/ec2000bef2c37dff4530075cb0297f4bb1f1ff7d.jpg

 Point C - The only indoor area with multiple floors and entry points
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/71f5a5bfb8bd8b7a10d839688f8453ea821adce1.jpg


The map includes structures that work well with the boost jump mechanics.

Coming Soon...

We can't reveal the exact date yet, but it's closer than you think.

More details coming soon. Stay tuned!

Sincerely,
Your AVA Operations Team

notes.title: New Tactical Tools: Special Weapons Now Available!
notes.content:
Mercenaries!

Special Weapons are now available in AVA Global, added through the May Update!

What Are Special Weapons?
Special weapons in AVA Global are unique armaments that provide tactical advantages beyond conventional firearms, enabling strategic gameplay opportunities. These specialized pieces of equipment are equipped in a dedicated special weapon slot, separate from standard weapon slots, with different types available for each class.

Special Weapons Types & Features

1. Healing Pistol
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/517617f4825c8f1f2404760f6f0f3cc3974d5009.png

 Class: Pointman
 Description: A medical pistol that fires adrenaline-filled capsules to restore health.
 Function: Restores HP to allies who have lost combat effectiveness due to low health.
 Key Features:
 - Restores a set amount of depleted HP when hitting allies
 - Deals damage to enemies, similar to a standard secondary weapon

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/775c912f1fed8b5b0fc5d727da29b4cbab92b98f.png

2. EMP Grenade
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/80b07bab79a3c4a870f7b8ebe37c403e47aba3ca.png

 Class: Rifleman
 Description: A throwable weapon that emits gamma rays upon detonation, affecting all electronic devices in its radius.
 Function: Significantly reduces enemy accuracy for a limited duration when hit by the electromagnetic pulse.
 Key Features:
- Temporarily disables weapon scope and zoom functions
- Prevents the use of binoculars during the EMP effect
- Deactivates night vision mode and drains the battery
- Hides crosshair display and lowers weapon accuracy during EMP effect

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/880a2b788520110281a04dcef1e9f294827bac24.png

3. Lightbulb
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/27be24832ba5a0872c691f011400f1342e7faa42.png

 Class: Sniper
 Description: A throwable device with significant impact when activated:
 Key Features:
- Creates glass fragments on the ground that make enemies' footsteps audible, even when they are walking
- Deals damage to enemies when hit

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/ec08d33c09bd9eb655a1f5ac171937a2af1e3a63.png
※ Note: The Lightbulb weapon is currently under development, and some features may be subject to change.

Where to Purchase?
Shop → Hot & NEW
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/ab0eca481bd5994ae84a557024d1558271d7da4e.png
※ Please note that each special weapon is purchasable only once at the in-game shop and is available for purchase for a limited period of 15 days.

How to Equip?
- Inventory → Special Weapons
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/04a16e4ac85ca2d6f81fd03044f6f9106be5e0c3.png

Quick Access
You can  use Special Weapons quickly by pressing Shortcut Key 6.

Sincerely,
Your AVA Operations Team

notes.title: Share Your Feedback on the April Update!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/69b7e9d38ea52178bb099c44a862b8a8b1b9fc61.png
Mercenaries!

As part of the April update, we’ve introduced several exciting changes to enhance your gameplay experience. These include updates to season rewards, the addition of the ultimate weapon, crosshair customization, weapon balance update, adjustments to Quick Match modes, and the introduction of the new mode - AirBorne. We’re eager to hear how these changes have impacted your time in the game!

Our development team continues to prioritize fixing in-game crash issues, and we are working diligently to identify and resolve their underlying causes. At the same time, your feedback is invaluable in guiding our efforts to improve future updates and refine the overall AVA experience.

Please take a moment to share your thoughts on the April update by completing our survey. Your feedback directly influences how we continue to evolve AVA Global.

[April Update Survey]

 Survey Link: https://forms.gle/Q1pPCby9VM9kdmVK9
 Alternative Link (for users in China): https://forms.office.com/r/nk111UatfG
 Survey Period: May 9 – May 18 (UTC)


============================================================
March Update Feedback Recap


Through the March Update survey, we’ve gathered the following key feedback and are sharing our direction with you:

[Weapon Balance]
Recent adjustments to weapon balance, as well as the new base weapon 'Gilboa', have received overall positive responses.
For Gilboa, players have evaluated it as having appropriate performance, rather than being overpowered, and many expressed hope for more well-adjusted weapons to be added in the future.

On the other hand, there are still ongoing concerns about the excessive performance of certain weapons such as the TC-9 and Raven Pro.
We are monitoring these balance issues closely and will be conducting a separate survey to gather more specific feedback on these weapons.

[New Maps]
The new maps 'Jinguashi' and 'Blind Eagle' have generally received high satisfaction.
'Blind Eagle' has been praised for its strategic gameplay, while there were mixed opinions about the map size of 'Jinguashi'.
Based on this feedback, we will continue focusing on designing maps that accommodate various playstyles.

[Quick Match Mode Feedback]
We’ve received various requests for improvements related to Quick Match rotation, mode configuration, and team balance.
In particular, we are aware of the issues with matchmaking difficulties in the EU region and the desire for players to freely play all maps, and we are considering ways to address these concerns.

For new maps and modes, we are balancing the introduction between Quick Match and Custom Channels.
In the future, new modes will be introduced to Quick Match first and gradually made available in Custom Channels after a period.
Through this approach, we aim to expand the environment where players can enjoy a variety of content freely.

[EXP & Level-Up Rewards]
Adjustments to AI experience points and kill targets have received positive feedback, but there were some concerns about level-up rewards.
Based on this feedback, we revamped the level-up reward system in the April update.
We will continue to review and monitor player feedback on these changes.

[Other Suggestions]
The frequently mentioned memory crash issues are currently being prioritized by the development team.
We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused by unexpected game closures or malfunctions.
We are thoroughly analyzing the cause of the issue and will do our best to resolve it quickly, ensuring a stable environment for players.

Additionally, we’ve received feedback on the skin combination system, rewards for players over level 200, and other areas.
We will continue to update the reward components on a monthly basis to ensure players above level 200 can still enjoy a steady flow of AVA Coins and engaging rewards.
============================================================

Your insights are crucial in helping AVA Global reach new heights. Thank you for being an essential part of the community!

Sincerely,
Your AVA Global Operations Team

notes.title: February Update Survey Results & Developer Feedback
notes.content:
Mercenaries,

Thank you for participating in the February update survey.
We have carefully reviewed every piece of feedback you provided.

The survey focused on five key areas, and we'd like to share the results and our development plans with everyone, including those who may not have participated but continue to enjoy playing AVA.

1&2) Weapon Rebalancing & Weapons Needing Adjustment

[Survey Results]
 While some players were satisfied with the current state, many were not.
 The most commonly raised issue was the polarization of weapon performance, especially concerns over the balance of older weapons.

[Developer Comments & Future Plans]

 Thank you for helping us review a wide range of feedback through this survey.
 Weapon balance will continue to be adjusted through upcoming updates, and we appreciate your continued interest and support.
 In future updates, we will prioritize ARs and SMGs and apply more careful and deliberate adjustments.
 While internal balance direction is important, we believe the most important goal is to ensure weapons are fun to play with.
We will prepare updates that will allow you to enjoy using more weapons through major balancing patches.
3) New Maps & Quick Match Mode Changes

[Survey Results]
 Reactions to the new maps were mixed, but many found them refreshing.
 However, many players expressed disappointment with the Quick Match mode changes, particularly hoping for the return of popular legacy modes.
 We also received feedback asking for a wider variety of maps to be available in Custom Channels.

[Developer Comments & Future Plans]

 In the case of Quick Match, we have continued to introduce various updates over time, but we've recognized that overall player satisfaction has not been high.
To refocus on AVA’s core battlefield experience, we plan to narrow our focus to a few key modes.
 However, since AVA offers a wide variety of modes, rather than fully reworking them, we are considering bringing back some as time-limited event modes.

4) Reward System Adjustments

[Survey Results]
 Some players appreciated the updates to attendance, daily, and season rewards.
 However, many felt the value and impact of rewards were insufficient.
 In particular, there were repeated comments about season rewards, capsule probabilities, and the quantity of AVA Coins

[Developer Comments & Future Plans]
 The development team shares your concerns regarding the reward system and will continue to review and apply improvements.

5) Season Level System

[Survey Results]
 Some players enjoyed the fast level progression, but many noted that rewards became less motivating after reaching level 200.
 There was also feedback from players who prefer the traditional rank system.

[Developer Comments & Future Plans]
 We aim to improve the season level system to make it more fun and continuously motivating.
 For example, we plan to offer honor-based rewards and enjoyable seasonal content, and seasonal items will be arranged differently from previous formats to keep things fresh.
 To address the drop in AVA Coin earnings after level 200, we are preparing quests and events to maintain consistent rewards.
 The original rank system will remain as the account-level rank, and we will continue to provide seasonal content and events that align with the seasonal progression system.
We hope you look forward to what's coming!

All the feedback collected from this survey has been shared internally and will be actively referenced when planning future updates.

Thank you once again for your continued support of A.V.A Global.
We’ll keep working hard to deliver a better gameplay experience.

Thank you.

Sincerely,
Your AVA Operations Team

notes.title: Dev Letter: Future Hard Core Balance Direction
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/2f717e48aba24c5c2317f5862885b18c2f3debf0.png
Hello, Mercenaries.

First of all, we would like to sincerely thank you for your continued interest and support for AVA Global.

Since the December update, many of you have shared various questions as well as feedback on areas that need improvement due to the changes made to the game.

We apologize for not providing a detailed explanation of the development direction earlier. In this announcement, we will address the questions and concerns you have raised.

What is the Direction of the Hardcore Balance?
The current balancing goal for AVA Global is to create a "hardcore" gaming environment.

Although we updated the balance based on the popular gameplay environment from 2011 to 2015 in the December update, we understand that this change might have been unexpected and challenging for some players.

To meet the expectations of our dedicated AVA fans, we are working to establish new standards and provide fresh weapon content.

1. Weapon Balance Adjustment Plan
The current weapon performance has been adjusted based on the balance from the most popular period between 2011 and 2015.
We have completed balance adjustments for approximately 160 weapons, and we will continue to refine the balance based on player feedback.
We will regularly update the base balance and respond quickly to any issues that arise.
Our goal is to enhance the content and appeal of various weapons.

2. Introducing New Performance for Weapon Classes
We are considering introducing new weapon tiers with expanded specifications and performance.
In addition to expanding weapon tiers, we are also exploring a crafting system that allows players to create new items through combinations.

What About the Addition of New Content?
We have been monitoring player feedback and gameplay patterns during the ongoing Pre-Season for the new Season Level System.
Based on this data, we are working on creating a season system that players can participate in without feeling burdened, while also enhancing the overall fun of gameplay.

1. Enhancing the Season System
Many players have requested faster level-ups during the Pre-Season. Therefore, we plan to reduce the experience points required to level up.
Additionally, we are considering the development of exclusive seasonal items to further increase the excitement of future seasons.

2. New Map Updates
We have analyzed the most popular maps from AVA’s history and have planned a new map that will enhance the intensity and thrill of combat.
The new map is designed to be simple yet engaging, providing exciting combat experiences with various strategic variables to keep players on their toes.

In addition to these updates, we are committed to providing a more complete game environment and diverse content in the future.

We greatly appreciate your continued support, feedback, and enthusiasm.
Please look forward to our upcoming updates, and do not hesitate to share your valuable thoughts with us.

*Please note that the content introduced above may be subject to change due to internal reasons.

notes.title: [Update Preview] Dec. New Map Open!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/0a0e8e9bbe1eed18ade2ae70fee4aa050519641a.png

Mercenaries!

In this December update, we are preparing multiple maps update!
You will experience various battlefields!

1.Escape - Last Break
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/691b28a73f2ef703f7cd83ea44756a4c511b9383.png

A new escape mode map, "The Last Break," has been added with the December update!

Unlike the other escape maps, combat in this map is simpler, but the engagement distances have been slightly extended. This feature offers players more strategic options.

With five alarm points, it might be challenging for the NRF team to defend. However, we have carefully designed the NRF base to ensure that they can effectively manage their defense.

Additionally, the map features an underground passage and three escape routes. Instead of crowding in one area, NRF players can establish defensive positions in the escape zones or at the entrances of each escape route to prevent the EU team from escaping easily.

Map Concept
The concept for this map is inspired by a neighboring area of one of AVA's iconic maps, "Fox Hunting." The EU base in Fox Hunting serves as the escape point in The Last Break, providing a thematic connection between the two maps.

2.Reaper flow
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/4fb515ee70aa9f1cbdd03ed20dfa5c9fb76fb631.png

Knife Battle Elimination Mode: During gameplay, you may notice players becoming the Hero.

When a player becomes the Hero, they can use a special weapon called the "Dragon Crescent Blade" for 30 seconds.

If the 30 seconds expire or they are killed by another player, the Hero status will transfer to their killer or the next eligible player.

While the Hero has the advantage of using the powerful "Dragon Crescent Blade," their character's silhouette will be visible to all players, so careful strategy is essential!

We sincerely thank all players who continue to support AVA Global!

To give everyone a refreshing change of pace when taking a break from shooting, we’ve created this lighthearted knife battle map.

Though it may have some shortcomings, we hope you enjoy it and share your valuable feedback. We will actively reflect your input to make continuous improvements.

See you on the battlefield!

*Please note that everything we are sharing today along with any mentioned information may be subject to change.

Thank you.

Sincerely,
Your AVA Global Team

notes.title: Dev Letter: Future Update Direction
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/5a270ffc2e5caf159d1fc1d8e6b43f6d456a8362.png

Dear Mercenaries,

Hello, this is PD of AVA Global.

We would like to express our gratitude to all our users and apologize for any inconvenience caused by the late announcement. Through this communication, we aim to clearly outline the path we envision for AVA Global.


Our goal with AVA Global was to adapt to the global environment and prevent weapon performance from becoming pay-to-win (PTW). We aimed to offer all weapons through free currency (Euros&Titanium) to maintain balanced performance and create an environment where players could enjoy a variety of items.


However, user demand for performance exceeded our expectations, and items such as skins did not convey the intended value to players. As a result, while several weapons were released, they became a source of frustration rather than enjoyment, highlighting areas that need improvement.

Therefore, beginning with the December update, we plan to shift to a more hardcore weapon balance and introduce a new direction centered on this adjustment.


Pursuit of Hardcore Appeal
We are planning to adjust all firearms to a more hardcore style. After establishing a base balance suited for combat, we will gradually release weapons with unique performance characteristics.

Introduction of a New Season System
Through system upgrades, we plan to retain AVA’s classic appeal while introducing a new seasonal ranking system. Our goal is to motivate users with continuous leveling and rewards.

Restoring the Value of Skins and Items
We plan to improve the skin system to offer performance upgrades that meet user expectations. Additionally, we aim to introduce features such as a Black Market to facilitate user-to-user trading and market activity.

Reward System Improvement
We are reviewing ways to provide meaningful rewards through a restructured reward system. Players will be able to earn various items through Arena Challenges.

AVA Global aims to provide a gaming experience that both embraces the memories of the past and continues to evolve.

We sincerely appreciate your continued interest and support.
*We hope you can share your thoughts regarding the A.V.A Global Future Updates!
*Please note that the content introduced above may be subject to change due to internal reasons.

Sincerely,
AVA Global PD

Mercenaries!

In the October update, we’re introducing a brand new combination system!

New Skin Combination List

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/62b9a856670534a34f6cd892347212a290c5c951.png

To make players obtain a new hidden unique tier skin: KO-93 Dominate, we've prepared a new rules with the highest unique jackpot chance ever!

For this new system, we carefully chose specific skins which most players have in A.V.A Global to make more players have a chance to obtain new skin: KO-93 Dominate.
Please note that you can obtain KO-93 Dominate through combining specific skins of the below list:

 Bhamut Bushman
 Bahamut Line of Steel
 Bahamut Dreamcatcher
 Verserk Urushi
 Bahamut Silvermoon
 Rok-1 sFortuna
 Verserk Sapphire
 Bahamut Bald Eagle
 Verserk Roswell
 Bahamut Red Valkyrie
 Desmodus Valentine
 Rok-1 March Turtle
 Bahamut Origin
 Bahamut Wishes
 Verserk Dragoon
 Bahamut Blue Valkyrie
 Bahamut Roswell
 Noel Desmodus
 Super V X-mas


"Skin Combination" is a mechanic of consuming two weapon skins to obtain a new weapon skin.

It is restricted to each group: Pointman, Rifleman, and Sniper.
Two weapons from the same group can be combined, and the weapon of the same group will be obtained through a combination process.

The Skin Combination system allows you to consume two weapon skins to create a new one. However, please note that once the skins are combined, they won’t be returned. The skins are grouped by class—Pointman, Rifleman, and Sniper—and can only be combined within the same group to obtain a new skin of the same class.

Tiers of weapons that can be used as Combination materials are "Regular," "Epic,", "Premium", and "Unique"

notes.title: September Update Note
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/c9bc490c47302062e83f83837fbf34396b3ed735.png

Mercenaries!

In this September update, we will add a variety of content  like the New Arena Format, New Weapons, and the New Map.

September Update Key Highlights:
-New Map Update
-New Arena Format
-New Skin Combination System items

New Map: Slim Fox
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/65a2300e65bbcedc4b23909723d1e5cfb0fe32cd.png

We are thrilled to announce the opening of a new demolition mission map that many of you have been eagerly waiting for!

The Slim Fox map is designed to integrate combat areas with the demolition points, allowing battles to occur anywhere on the map. The fast-paced action near the bomb sites intensifies the EU/NRF conflict like never before! Prepare for intense combat in every corner of the battlefield.

New Arena Format
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/237741ef44edd3331d444c76eefe094481454d8e.jpg

The Arena mode is getting a complete overhaul!

The new Arena format allows more users to participate, with greater opportunities to earn limited-time rewards. You can now gain significant rewards even with a single match. This update improves the competitive balance among all users and ensures everyone has a chance to earn rewards.

New Skin Combination System
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/ce95cf561f27e30845638dd5f607ad48c6b2a1a3.png

In this update, we’re introducing three new Unique Tier skins!
Pointman Unique Skin: XG552 Autumn Deer
Rifleman Unique Skin: X1 Gran Nobility
Sniper Unique Skin: SW.338 Raid Order

The Skin Combination system allows you to consume two weapon skins to create a new one. However, please note that once the skins are combined, they won’t be returned. The skins are grouped by class—Pointman, Rifleman, and Sniper—and can only be combined within the same group to obtain a new skin of the same class.

It is restricted to each group: Pointman, Rifleman, and Sniper.
Two weapons from the same group can be combined, and the weapon of the same group will be obtained through a combination process.

Tiers of weapons that can be used as Combination materials are "Regular," "Epic,", "Premium", and "Unique"

After the September Update, the new skin combination skins will be available.

New Weapon
With the September update, the new weapon X1921 will be added!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/951c82bd16337f0416183f9caf4f7e4a0aad0203.png

This weapon will initially be available for purchase in the in-game store using Titanium, and later, it will also be available for purchase with Euros.

New Box Open:
-Galactica Box: Contains 3 types Galactica Series limited skins(KT-SC Galactica, Walt-2000 Galactica, R93 Galatica), 24 types of limited skins, in-game items and euros.
-You can obtain Galactica Box through In-game Play Reward & Attendance Reward

Galaxy Box: Contains 4 types Galactica Series limited skins(T-65 Galactica, Walt-2000 Galactica, R93 Galatica, XG550 Galatica), 24 types of limited skins, in-game items.
-You can obtain Galaxy Box through In-game Shop(Euro).

Capsule Shop Update:
Pointman, Rifleman, Sniper Capsules are available for obtaining jackpot skins with 100% obtainable system.

Bug Fix
-FNC Golden Drill item bug fix
-MA-107 Troll Snake item bug fix
-X24 Bianca item bug fix

*Please note that the content introduced above may be subject to change due to internal reasons.

We hope you enjoy all the new content added through the update!

Thank you.

Sincerely,

Your AVA Global Operations Team

notes.title: 2nd Mercevarsary Party is Here!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/d6c1cf2811df8f9a275d55b022d8ce1424dbc3f7.jpg

Key Words:

 
  1. New Mode: Death Valley Classic Mode Open!
  2. New System: Weapon Pass Open!
  3. 1 Euro Anniversary Event Pass Open!
  4. New Limited Update Box Jackpot Chance UP!
 


2nd Anniversary Greetings

As you already know, August 25th holds a special place in our hearts, marking the second anniversary of AVA Global. Since our launch, we've been tirelessly delivering enriching content, with much more in the pipeline. Your unwavering interest and heartfelt feedback have made our journey thus far possible.

The memories of AVA Global's debut on that remarkable day still resonate with us, igniting our passion. However, beyond this significant milestone, we're excited to unveil what lies ahead in the coming years!

New Modes: Death Valley Classic Mode Open!

To celebrate our 2nd anniversary, we are introducing a new mode: Death Valley Classic. Death Valley has been a highly anticipated mode for quite some time now, and we're thrilled to finally be able to bring it to you after meticulous development, ensuring seamless integration into the AVA global experience.

Death Valley places teamwork at its core, promising a captivating and engaging experience. 

This fresh mode comes with a unique hidden reward distinct from our existing Death Valley 2 pocket rewards. Stay tuned!

New System: 1 Euro Anniversary Pass & Weapon Pass System

For this 2nd Anniversary, a new limited event pass will be opened. We've prepared a unique 2nd Anniversary Event Pass(1 Euro Only!) for all users.

Plus, we're attentive to your feedback, and in response to the observations made about the New System: Weapon Pass system in the August Update. These refinements will expedite the acquisition of exclusive skins, as we persistently strive to enhance your gaming journey.

Furthermore, our commitment extends to other in-game enhancements. Stay tuned for more details in our upcoming announcements.

Sneak Peek: August Update Skin Preview

Recent patches have unveiled exciting new weaponry like the GA-28, paired with exceptional skins to complement them. The upcoming August update keeps this tradition alive.

As we approach the update, we're delighted to offer a glimpse into the array of new amazing skins awaiting you. 

New Limited Box Pre-Reservation Event

Furthermore, we prepared an event for you to get the ‘New Update Box’ at the earliest after the August update with Jackpot chances UP!: Login A.V.A Global every day for a limited time before the update, and receive the ‘New Update Box’ x [the number of days you logged in].

MISSION: Log in to A.V.A Global every day for a limited time
REWARD: New Update Box *5EA
Hidden Mission: If you fulfill 6 days of log-in, you will receive another 10 New Boxes.
*All rewards will be sent within 3 business days after the event concludes.

Come to A.V.A Global on the last days before the August update, and don’t miss the chance to get the ‘New Update Box’ the fastest!
*Please note that everything we are sharing today along with any mentioned information may be subject to change.

Thank you.

Sincerely

A.V.A Global Operation Team

notes.title: Dev Letter: Weapon Balance Update Announcement
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/e2150a3f547ec0c1eaabcea1fb117e295eec1a0a.png

Dear Mercenaries,

At AVA Global, we are conducting a phased update to expand the core shooting experience unique to AVA Global. Based on user survey results, we are moving forward with a weapon balance update for Phase 3.

Weapon Balance Improvement Phase 3! Return of the Popular Mainstream Weapons!

Following the recent survey, we have once again realized that the weapons preferred by users are classic weapons such as the MA-47 and Cannon. Therefore, we are planning a balance adjustment focused on classic firearms, actively reflecting your opinions. Additionally, we are analyzing factors such as weapon usage rates and win rates to address weapon imbalance issues.

List of Balance Update Weapons
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/561cc6700e57025238f5b4d1949f0d973d457a76.png

We will continue to monitor the utilization and performance of user weapons, and we will closely observe less frequently used weapons considering the current balance. Our goal is to ensure that each weapon in AVA Global has its own unique identity and functionality. We are committed to careful review and ongoing balance updates. Although this process may take some time, we deeply appreciate your patience and understanding as we strive for optimal results.

With the news of the balance update, we have also prepared a bonus announcement. This is a great opportunity to obtain popular skins for 11 types of weapons scheduled for balance adjustments! We appreciate your keen interest. 
Announcement Link: (Link)

Thank you.

Sincerely,
Your AVA Global Team

notes.title: [New Mode is Coming!] The Mission Has Gone To Hell!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/cd39c2076d652fcf4e459518649eb1f4ba436939.png

Mercenaries!

We embarked on the 'Busters' project with the aim of enhancing your gaming experience while staying true to the essence of AVA Global.

Our goal was to explore various aspects of AVA Global through a spin-off format.

Given the popularity of AVA Global's past PvE content, we decided to reinterpret it with a fresh perspective.

By emphasizing the 'survival' element, we are introducing a 'top-down shooting' method to offer a distinctive experience compared to other survival games.

During this development, we created a new feature called the 'tactical suit.'

Look forward to a unique experience of AVA, filled with tense battles and modern weapons!
*Please note that everything we are sharing today along with any mentioned information may be subject to change

notes.title: April Skin Combination Update!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/5ac0ee58365d617e0a9303de9e03dd372a2a4444.png

Mercenaries!

"Skin Combination" is a mechanic of consuming two weapon skins to obtain a new weapon skin.

It is restricted to each group: Pointman, Rifleman, and Sniper.
Two weapons from the same group can be combined, and the weapon of the same group will be obtained through a combination process.

Tiers of weapons that can be used as Combination materials are "Regular," "Epic,", "Premium", and "Unique".

After the April Update, the new skin combination rule will be available in the Pointman&Rifleman&Sniper Skins Combination System.

We prepared a new rule for Pointman&Rifleman&Sniper skins to make users use the specific existing premium tier skin to obtain a new Unique tier skin.

Pointman Skin Combination Rule:

[Regular + Regular]
a. Epic: Bahamut Bushman
b. Regular Skins

[Epic + Epic]
a. Premium : 870 Red Skull
b. Epic: Epic Skins
- 870 Red Skull: 25%
- Epic Skins: 75%

[Premium + Premium]
a. Unique Skins: 25%
b. Premium Skins: 75%

[Unique + Premium]
a. Unique Skins: 50%
b. Premium Skins: 50%

[Unique + Unique]
a. Unique Skins: 100%
*Please note that the content introduced above may be subject to change due to internal reasons.

Rifleman Skin Combination Rule:

[Regular + Regular]
a. Epic: X36 Gila
b. Regular Skins

[Epic + Epic]
a. Premium : Hawk416 Sci-FI
b. Epic: Epic Skins
- X16VN Pacifism: 25%
- Epic Skins: 75%

[Premium + Premium]
a. Unique Skins: 25%
b. Premium Skins: 75%

[Unique + Premium]
a. Unique Skins: 50%
b. Premium Skins: 50%

[Unique + Unique]
a. Unique Skins: 100%
*Please note that the content introduced above may be subject to change due to internal reasons.

Sniper Skin Combination Rule:

[Regular + Regular]
a. Epic: EPKO Panzer
b. Regular Skins

[Epic + Epic]
a. Premium: V Nagant Jager Florian
b. Epic: Epic Skins
- V Nagant Jager Florian: 25%
- Epic Skins: 75%

[Premium + Premium]
a. Unique Skins: 25%
b. Premium Skins: 75%

[Unique + Premium]
a. Unique Skins: 50%
b. Premium Skins: 50%

[Unique + Unique]
a. Unique Skins: 100%
*Please note that the content introduced above may be subject to change due to internal reasons.

Note: 
>Eoak A2 Maple Damask(Unique Tier) is exclusively attainable through the skins acquired from the Skin Combination System(Rifleman).
>You can obtain EVO 3 Chameleon(Unique Tier) through the Skin Combination System(Pointman).

notes.title: OPS/DEV LETTER: Large-Scale Diverse Weapon Update Plan Phase 2
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/eabeaf775c6747f92d71f309574ff90e20127740.jpg

Mercenaries!

AVA Global has carried out a massive firearms update in the March update, and in the next step, we plan to focus on expanding the shooting experience,

which is a core fun aspect of AVA Global, by repositioning new firearms beyond increasing gun diversity.

As mentioned before, we plan to carry out the overall weapon balance work in three stages, and from this upcoming update,

we will apply our second stage plan to enhance AVA Global's core fun and gameplay.


 Stage 1 New Balance: Massive new weapon addition update (March update)
 
 Stage 2 Rebalance: Creating a new weapon ecosystem enhanced in gameplay through expanding gun modification content by skin tier (planned for April update)
 
 Stage 3 Post Balance: Strengthen balance management based on diverse user experiences in the newly changed environment - details to be announced later


Position reorganization through the expansion of gun modification content After the massive base weapon update,

the next step will involve repositioning work on weapons through the application of modification rights points by skin tier.

Through the Rebalance work, we aim to realize an experience where players can select from more competitive and diverse weapons and play the game with personality by expanding the in-game modification rights content.

We are confident that this process will positively affect your gameplay.

This will be a key process for the upcoming Post-Balancing stage and continuous balance management for a new weapon ecosystem will be planned.

With the April update, we will bring a completely new shooting fun and provide a service that gives you anticipation.

Your continuous interest, participation, and valuable opinions are a great help in further developing AVA Global.

We will continue to strengthen communication with you and do our best to provide a better gaming experience.

Thank you.

Sincerely,
A.V.A Global Team

notes.content:

Mercenaries! 

Thank you for your enthusiastic interest and support following our last major weapon update.

With this weapon update, you now have access to a wider variety of weapons, and the upcoming April update will introduce skin grading and more benefits for all users after the April update.

A.V.A Global Care Package:

 Enhanced Rewards for New Users
 Expanded Distribution of Weapon Mod Tickets

Enhanced Rewards for New Users
First, we plan to enhance rewards for new users. 
From now on, new users will receive generous welcome rewards, including three types of in-game weapon skins and a base weapon box simply by creating a character. Create your character and immediately join in the fun with your new skins!

Expanded Distribution of Weapon Mod Tickets
Additionally, you will soon be able to obtain mod ticket rewards from the battle pass and attendance rewards. 
This will provide more rewards to everyone enjoying the gun mod content with the April skin grading update. Users will be able to obtain mod tickets daily through various in-game rewards, enabling more diverse gunplay.

notes.title: OPS/DEV LETTER: Large-Scale Diverse Weapon Update Plan
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/eabeaf775c6747f92d71f309574ff90e20127740.jpg

Mercenaries,

AVA Global has implemented a custom channel update in February, dedicated to fostering an environment where you can fully immerse yourself in the allure of AVA Global. 
Moving forward, our focus has shifted towards enriching the unparalleled shooting experience within the game rather than altering the environment.

Today, we're excited to share our upcoming plans and insights with you.

We're gearing up for a significant operation concerning firearms, a pivotal aspect of the game. 
Our strategy involves executing a three-stage base weapon balance operation. 
With the imminent update, we'll promptly roll out the first stage to elevate the core excitement and gameplay of AVA Global.


 Stage 1 New Balance: Starting with an update of 50 or more weapons, followed by continuous updates with the addition of new weapons.
 Stage 2 Re-Balancing: Creating a new weapon ecosystem with enhanced gameplay through the repositioning of all weapons.
 Stage 3 Post-Balance: Strengthening balance management based on various user experiences in the newly changed environment.


Stage 1: New Balance 
- Diversified Firearms:
AVA Global is set to expand the arsenal of firearms available in-game, ensuring a more comprehensive reflection of your unique strategies and play styles. 
Expect over 50 new base weapons to be introduced, offering players a diverse selection to tailor their loadouts to their individual roles. 
Through in-game stores and events, we'll diversify acquisition avenues and adjust Euro sale prices to make new weapons more accessible, enriching your experience with strategic depth and gameplay enjoyment unique to AVA Global.

Stage 2: Re-Balancing 
- Strategic Weapon Repositioning:
Following the comprehensive update of 50 base weapons, the subsequent phase will focus on strategically repositioning the new additions.
Our goal with re-balancing is to foster a more competitive and varied gameplay experience, empowering players to choose and personalize their weapons. 
We're confident this process will positively impact your gameplay.

Stage 3: Post-Balance 
- Continuous Ecosystem Management:
After completing the initial two stages, we'll embark on ongoing balance management to further enhance the core excitement of AVA Global.

notes.title: Ops Team Letter: Custom Channel Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/1a806ad7687e58043b7aa42ad417194ef47da23b.png

Mercenaries,

We're thrilled to share some exciting updates that will enrich your gaming experience and make daily play more enjoyable and consistent.

Following your valuable feedback, we've made several enhancements that emphasize ease of navigation, engagement, and rewards.

1. Map Reorganization for a Smoother Experience
Based on your feedback, we have reorganized our map selection to focus more on the original, beloved maps.

This reorganization aims to lower the difficulty of navigation, making it easier for everyone to enjoy the game.

2. Incorporating Your Voice: Improved Map Selection
We've listened to your voices through various channels and have included maps that have recently received positive responses, including those favored for sniper and elimination modes.

Your input is invaluable, and we're excited to reflect it in our game.

3. Unified Gameplay Modes for Enhanced Engagement
To improve match immersion and facilitate natural learning, we've unified certain gameplay modes, specifically around demolition missions.

This change will provide a more consistent and engaging experience across matches.

4. PVE Channel: Understanding the Delay
We're aware of the growing anticipation and realize that some of you may be curious about the reasons for the delay in the feature's implementation.

Our commitment is to not just meet but to far exceed your expectations with the PvE channels. Our team has dedicated itself to crafting a stable and seamless gameplay environment that integrates flawlessly with the game's current framework.

We are convinced that this additional time invested in development will culminate in a more refined and enjoyable experience for all.

Anticipating the PvE Channels
The forthcoming PvE channels will encompass the modes we've previously announced, offering a diverse range of gameplay experiences.

Whether you're taking on AI adversaries or collaborating with friends to achieve distinct objectives, there will be something to cater to every player's taste.

This update signifies a step forward in our continuous mission to enrich the game's content and expand the ways you can immerse yourself in the game world.

We are diligently finalizing the PvE channels and eagerly await the moment you can dive into the new content.

Your patience and unwavering support are incredibly valuable to us. We firmly believe that the wait will be thoroughly rewarding.

5. Daily Rank Purpose and Enhanced Rewards
We're redefining the purpose of Daily Rank to make it accessible for more casual participation while significantly boosting rank rewards.

This adjustment aims to encourage daily play without the pressure, rewarding your dedication and skill with more substantial incentives.

These updates are designed to make your gaming experience more rewarding and enjoyable every day.

We appreciate your feedback and are committed to continually improving the game based on your suggestions.

Dive in, explore the changes, and enjoy the enhanced gameplay and rewards!

Thank you for being a part of our community.

Sincerely,
Your AVA Global Operation Team

notes.title: Skin Combination System Update!

Mercenaries!

"Skin Combination" is a mechanic of consuming two weapon skins to obtain a new weapon skin.

It is restricted to each group: Pointman, Rifleman, and Sniper.
Two weapons from the same group can be combined, and the weapon of the same group will be obtained through a combination process.

Tiers of weapons that can be used as Combination materials are "Regular," "Epic," and "Premium."

After the February Update, the new skin combination rule will be available in the Rifleman&Sniper Skins Combination System.

notes.title: February Update Preview
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/1a998f874ae028898a9cc359d6827bb4c67bfe80.jpg

Mercenaries!

In this February update, we will add a variety of content centered around the long-awaited custom channels.

The development of custom channels is already in its final stage, and new content that will enrich the custom channels further is scheduled to be updated sequentially.

Over the past few months, A.V.A Global has conducted a massive update and has incorporated various feedback from you, including the custom channels, new season HEX, and new maps, among other elements, to be added in this update.

February Update Preview:
1. Custom Rooms
We are very excited to share interesting development news about custom rooms, which many of you have been waiting for. We are preparing to meet your expectations and sincerely thank you for your patience.

The custom rooms, currently in the final stage of preparation, aim to provide a space carefully designed for an enhanced personalized experience.

With this February update, modes like Demolition, Annihilation, Sniper Annihilation, AI Mode, Breakthrough, and Escape are scheduled for early update, with PVE modes to follow sequentially.

Our goal is to create a dynamic and specialized environment reflecting the features you desire. Beyond this, by introducing customized rooms, we are opening new possibilities for the community.

We are thrilled about the upcoming release of user-customized channels, paving the way for tournaments and events led by Game Masters (GMs).

This additional feature is designed to introduce competition and community aspects to the platform, enabling personalized experiences and providing an environment for thrilling competitions and events.

Please stay tuned for an updated guide related to custom rooms before the update.

2. New Season: HEX(100% Medal Pay-Back!)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/3c96f9f0766d5d7e94cce0d618cf03a622a656b4.jpg

For A.V.A Global, the Battle Pass is one of the key contents that offers users limited season skins, in-game currency, and various rewards. Based on your feedback, we have extended the Battle Pass level range and introduced a tutorial level-up system among other initiatives.

As this has been a highly anticipated update, we have received various feedback from users. Accordingly, as many have mentioned, the HEX season is scheduled to be reflected in this massive update.

To show our appreciation for your support and interest, this season will feature a special "100% MEDAL PAY-BACK" activity (Exclusive).

This Battle Pass section will allow all users to obtain all modifiable HEX series primary weapons, ensuring a diverse collection of limited skins.

3. New Maps
With this update, a variety of new maps, led by Windmill, will be coming your way.

Windmill is set to launch as a new Sniper Annihilation mode, eagerly awaited by many users, and will include additional new maps linked with custom rooms, providing a fresh and fun experience unlike anything seen in A.V.A Global before.

In Conclusion
Since the January update, A.V.A Global has been preparing updates aimed at enhancing the unique fun of A.V.A Global gameplay.

Besides the content mentioned earlier, a skin combination system and a new skin series are also scheduled for this update, so we ask for your keen interest.

As always, we are continuously researching new ways to enhance the A.V.A Global gaming experience and are always listening to your valuable feedback on upcoming new systems and content.

Please look forward to more detailed information about our new development work through patch notes and announcements in future updates.

notes.title: Skin Combination System Update (Sniper)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/e73878e2452db92d34b929b80cce442785897353.jpg

Mercenaries!

"Skin Combination" is a mechanic of consuming two weapon skins to obtain a new weapon skin.

It is restricted to each group: Pointman, Rifleman, and Sniper.
Two weapons from the same group can be combined, and the weapon of the same group will be obtained through a combination process.

Tiers of weapons that can be used as Combination materials are "Regular," "Epic," and "Premium."

After the January Update, the new skin combination rule will be available in the Sniper Skin Combination System.
Additionally, a completely new rule will be applied to each faction, allowing users to obtain higher-tier skins with increased probabilities.
We prepared a new rule for Sniper skins to make users use the Battle Pass skin [X40A5 Valentine] to obtain a new Unique tier skin.

a. Epic: EPKO Panzer

Mercenaries!

First of all, we would like to express our gratitude for the tremendous support you have shown since the official release of A.V.A Global in August 2022. 
We take this opportunity to share with you the key updates scheduled for January.

New Mode
In the upcoming January update, we are introducing the 'Prison Break: Escape' Co-op AI mode. 
We have been preparing various content additions that users have been eagerly anticipating since the January update. 

Please understand that due to system optimization requirements in the global environment, existing modes may not be immediately added.

The 'Prison Break: Escape' mode in this update offers non-stop enemy encounters, shooting gameplay, and the excitement of annihilating enemies and escaping the map. 
The rules of survival and escape unique to this mode will provide a thrilling experience.

New Battle Pass 
The new Battle Pass introduced in this update addresses feedback received on Battle Pass rewards, especially the high demand for free distribution of limited edition skins. 

In this Battle Pass, both free and paid users will have the opportunity to obtain limited edition skins. The theme for these skins revolves around Valentine's Day.

Additionally, regular Battle Pass and Battle Pass bundle users will be able to obtain high-tier skins through the skin combination system.

Detailed information about the Battle Pass will be provided in future announcements.

Enhanced Skin Combination System Rules
The skin combination system allows A.V.A Global users to upgrade regular skins to epic skins and further to higher-tier skins. 

We have made various improvements to the skin combination system based on user feedback, and the rules will be enhanced in this update.

The feedback regarding the probability increase adjustment in the skin combination system, particularly at the Epic to Premium stage, has been considered. 
The January update will include adjustments to increase the probability at this stage. 
Additionally, a completely new rule will be applied to each faction, allowing users to obtain higher-tier skins with increased probabilities.

Detailed information about the skin combination system update will be available in future announcements.

Weapon Modification Feedback 
The Weapon Mod system is one of A.V.A Global's main features, allowing users to customize firearms to create their own skins. 
In the January update, three(existing skins) premium-grade Mod weapons for each class will be added to the modification weapon list.
LIST: Super V Woodpecker, MA-74M War Machine, SW.338 Uranus

As mentioned before, we are aware of the significant impact the modification system can have on firearm balance. 
We are approaching this cautiously and will continue to analyze data and improve based on your feedback even after the update.

In conclusion, with the January update, numerous in-game features will be improved based on user feedback. 
We are considering various opinions and will share more detailed information in future announcements.

We will continue to listen to user opinions and feedback, and we look forward to your high expectations for the January update.

notes.content:

Mercenaries,

We appreciate the tremendous support and encouragement for the progress we shared on January 17th.

Thank you for the support and encouragement you've shown for the information we provided on January 17th.

AVA Global Update Direction:
STEP 1: Adding the PVE mode you asked for, reinforcing game MODE feedback
- New PVE mode:
Since the launch of AVA Global, users have been requesting the release of various PVE modes.
In response to this feedback, we have introduced a variety of modes such as AVA Train, Death Valley, and Overrider.
While many users have enjoyed these modes, we have received numerous requests for improvements to these mode updates.
We are currently working on preparations to introduce a new PVE mode as quickly as possible,
and we hope to share the news of the mode update with you through the January update.

Reinforcement of Weapon MOD System feedback:
Alongside this, there will be a revision to the Weapon MOD system.

we are planning to distribute Weapon MOD Tickets abundantly.

each branch will add one existing weapon to its list in the January update.

We plan to revamp it in a direction where you can utilize a variety of weapons according to your play style in the mid to long term.

In the process of setting this direction, we will continuously share intermediate situations with you.
We will carefully consider and proceed with the rebalancing based on your valuable feedback.

In addition, we are preparing to introduce even more diverse new content,
and we will continue to communicate with you and build together in the future.

Thank you.

Sincerely,
Your AVA Global Operation Team

notes.title: Ops Team honest talk: Feedback, Balance, and News
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/e2fd59341aefb27d3047eb39a9ff307ba48814d5.png
Mercenaries,

In A.V.A Global, exciting developments continue to unfold, and we are pleased to share the progress with you. 
Thank you for providing various opinions related to the Weapon Modification System. 
Your feedback is highly valued, and the operations/development team actively considers it for fair gameplay.

Balance:
We recognize that many of you prioritize game balance. AVA had plans for character specialization as part of the direction for game improvement. 
Adjustments, including HP increases, were made considering future updates and balance, but due to unfavorable player experiences, a quick rollback(of -20hp) was decided.
We are currently in careful discussions about the balance direction, aggregating opinions from users such as "one-shot headshot" and "classic model adjustments." 
We aim to improve in the optimal direction by listening to your opinions, not just the thoughts of the AVA team. Please bear with us a little longer.

Feedback Implementation:
Firstly, we anticipate being able to share good news with you soon. 
We are preparing the most-requested feature, custom room creation, and appreciate your patience for the slight delay in ensuring a stable environment. 
We are also carefully reviewing modes to be included in custom rooms and welcome your input.

Modification System:
Aware of the significant impact the modification system can have on gun balance, we approached it cautiously. 
Initially, the system was designed to minimize the impact on individual gun modifications. 
We are now preparing to provide clearer feedback on the system's effects, addressing the unclear aspects based on continuous data analysis and user feedback.

Game play Rewards:
Feedback regarding a shortage of in-game currency, Euro, hindering the utilization of the special store content, has been acknowledged. 
To address this, we introduced the new "Euro Box" to increase the Euro amount obtainable after each game. 
The Euro Box is now part of daily quests and includes a variety of premium items in the Supreme Box (Titanium, Euro), excluding AVA BOX and Premium BOX. 
This allows you to choose rewards according to your play style, and we will swiftly apply additional opinions.

Counteraction against Unfair Practices:
We are consistently addressing unfair practices such as illegal programs and bug exploitation. 
Through automated detection systems, reviewing reported content, and various methods, we respond robustly. 
Monthly updates on our official website inform the community of the actions taken. 
We commit to continuing strong measures against unfair users.

Ban List for Unfair Practices: https://www.avaonline.global/?mKey=1&sKey=1#board/list/892/N

Thank you.

Sincerely,
Your AVA Global Operation Team

notes.title: December Update Developer Notes
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/c337b8f3f1bcc7e18569e0b99b7b5d517c334e0e.png
Mercenaries!

One of the most important aspects at A.V.A Global is the shooting play. Utilizing various weapons in-game to navigate the battlefield and progressing through gameplay with suitable strategies for each battlefield is a crucial element at A.V.A Global. Over the next few months, A.V.A Global is planning extensive updates to provide you with a more enjoyable gaming environment. Today, we will share updates regarding these plans and upcoming patches.

December Update Preview:

Battle Pass Renewal:
The Battle Pass at A.V.A Global is a major content where many users can obtain diverse rewards such as limited-season skins and in-game currency. Based on user feedback, we have attempted various changes, including extending Battle Pass level ranges and introducing a tutorial level-up system.

However, many users mentioned that the Battle Pass cycle is too long. Therefore, starting from this December, the Battle Pass duration will decrease to match each update period. Although the duration is shorter than the previous three months, the overall rewards will include seasonal limited skins at the same level as three update rewards. In the December Battle Pass, you can experience various "Christmas" themed skins, and it will be designed to offer a more diverse range of skins for all users during the December update. Additionally, a larger-scale change is planned for January next year, so we appreciate your participation.

New Game Maps&Modes:
With this map update, White Out and Break Out maps will be introduced, and White Out, a new Breach mode that many users have been anticipating, will be released.

Furthermore, the newly added Break Out mode, Steal and Escape, will be a completely new and entertaining mode that you haven't experienced in A.V.A Global.
 
Daily Match System:
Additionally, the December update will introduce the Daily Match system. Unlike Arena Match, Daily Match will offer a fast pace fun for users. While Arena is a "Hardcore" system where skilled players compete for the highest skill and top-tier rewards, Daily Match will provide a relatively lighter but compact match system. Players can earn much more rewards in a short playtime compared to the existing Quick Match rewards.

As this is the first time for this content, the December update will be conducted in a "Free Season" format. We plan to continuously improve based on your feedback.

Also, new items will be added to the "Ultimate Unique Soldier Box," which was tentatively distributed in the previous Arena. So, we ask for your interest in both Daily Match and Arena Season.

Special Shop:
We have presented attractive skins through various capsules and boxes, and many users have provided feedback on capsule shops and in-game shops. Based on your feedback, a Special Shop with high accessibility and easy participation will be added. Through this new shop, you can obtain a more diverse range of items. Please check for details in future announcements.
 

Goals for the January 2024 Update:
While December is focused on new attempts, January 2024 is preparing for an update in the direction of providing a unique enjoyment of A.V.A Global gameplay. Although detailed information will be revealed in the future as development is ongoing, the next update is planned to prepare A.V.A Global users to feel the core fun of A.V.A more clearly.

To achieve this, we are developing the Custom Channel and Black Market as development goals for the first quarter of 2024. A large-scale update is planned to enhance the core fun of A.V.A Global, so we ask for your interest not only in the December update but also in the content to be added in January 2024.

In conclusion...

Our ultimate goal in the development plan is to provide a better playing environment that aligns with how players enjoy the game today. As always, we will continuously research new ways to enhance the A.V.A Global gaming experience, and we always value your valuable feedback on upcoming new systems and content.

Please stay tuned for more detailed information on the new development work we have prepared through patch notes and announcements in future updates.

Thank you.
A.V.A Global Operations Team

notes.title: Skin Combination New Season (Weapon Modification System!)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/835ea0fe26264472e51967f509abaff6ee8b2f6e.png

Mercenaries!

"Skin Combination" is a mechanic of consuming two weapon skins to obtain a new weapon skin.

It is restricted to each group: Pointman, Rifleman, and Sniper.
Two weapons from the same group can be combined, and the weapon of the same group will be obtained through a combination process.
Tiers of weapons that can be used as Combination materials are "Regular," "Epic," and "Premium."

Skin Combination System New Season!
We've made a slight change to the system, where you can now obtain specially combined skins via this system.

Two weapons from the same group can be combined, and a tier higher (or the same) skin is obtained through the combination process.
This change will be implemented after the November Update.

Furthermore, there will be multiple ways to obtain modifiable weapons for the Weapon Modification System, and the Skin Combination System will be one of them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/d90a0dc10932641a3a475ff0ca66a4da3e8a05d7.png

If you proceed with the Skin Combination, you will consume a certain amount of Euros.
Weapons used as materials for Combination will NOT be returned.

Skins Update - From Skin Combination, general Unique, Premium, and Epic tier skins cannot be obtained.

However, there are 6 skins that can only be obtained through Skin Combination.

For example, if you combine two Epic skins, you will receive either an Epic or Premium skin.

Example: (Sniper)
[Regular + Regular]
a. Epic : Epko Panzer
b. Regular Skins

[Epic + Epic]
a. Premium : V Nagant Jager Florian
b. Epic : Epko Panzer

[Premium + Premium]
a. Unique: Ballista Chronos
b. Premium: V Nagant Jager Florian
Note: 
>The skins(Premium and Unique tier) shown below are exclusively attainable through the skins acquired from the Skin Combination System.
>The exclusive Epic skins shown below are attainable through the Regular skins from Combination Box.

Try to obtain these rare Unique skins through Skin Combination.

notes.title: DEV LETTER: November Update!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/d334bdf024405f753a633967a964b52cc61bfcce.png

Mercenaries!

As you may already know, since its launch, AVA Global has introduced various weapons and skins, a variety of PVE modes through constant updates, and new content based on what you've been telling us!

We still can't get over the day we launched AVA Global and gave our users their first taste of the game, and it's still a fantastic memory for us. That's why we've always listened to your comments and feedback, and we're always thinking about how we can make your gaming experience with AVA Global even more enjoyable.

AI Mode Launch

With the November update, we're introducing a new mode, AI Demolition Mode, which will be available in Quick Match. AI Demolition Mode has been a highly anticipated mode for many of our users, and we're thrilled to finally bring it to you after a lot of development and adaptation to the AVA Global environment.

This AI Demolition Mode is all about the shooter aspect of the game, so it will be a lot of fun to utilize the shooting and weaponry unique to AVA Global. 

Stay tuned for more details on this new mode!

Improved Gun Content

As everyone knows, the core content of AVA Global is gunplay & skins, and we believe that gunplay with various maps is one of the most essential parts of the AVA Global gaming experience.

That's why we've been thinking about how we can make your gaming experience with AVA Global more enjoyable.

With this update, we're introducing a new system, the Gun Modification System, which will allow you to create and play with your own guns. Of course, the Gun Modification System isn't just a gun enhancement system, it will allow you to customize your guns to suit your own playstyle. In addition, Gun Modification System-enabled guns will also be available to free-to-play users, and we will continue to improve the system through future updates.

New Balance Improvements

We wanted every item to be an "attractive item" in-game, and we worked hard to create a game environment where users could choose from all the items and have a variety of fun.

In addition to this, we are constantly evolving the game to create a game environment where more diverse items (characters & weapons) perform better and to diversify further the routes users can take to enjoy the fun of shooting.

This requires a careful approach to ensure that the core gameplay fun of AVA Global is maintained without compromising the game experience for all AVA Global users, and we've taken into account the various balance suggestions you've provided through various channels, such as the gun modification system. Plus, character HP balance rollbacks will be patched.

Of course, this isn't the end of our balancing work, as we'll continue to listen to you and actively incorporate your feedback into future updates and development.

We believe this proactive approach to communicating with you will only make AVA Global a more fun game to play. 

Last but not least, we will continue to make updates in various areas, such as item balancing and adding new modes, and we will do our best to ensure a fair and stable in-game environment. Although these tasks will not be solved with just a few patches, we will not give up.

We want everyone to have fun in AVA Global, and we hope you'll stay tuned for future growth and updates.

*Please note that the content introduced above may be subject to change due to internal reasons.


Thank you.

Sincerely,

Your AVA Global Operations Team

Players start by parachuting onto the battlefield. 
As you descend, assess the locations of other users and strategize accordingly. 
You can choose to land in a safe area with fewer opponents, an area rich in items and potential battles, or even on a rooftop to avoid the initial chaos.

Keep in mind that item locations change constantly, so start by exploring and collecting items scattered throughout the map to aid in your survival.

While wandering, you may encounter other players. If you feel confident in your abilities, challenge them to a battle, defeat them, and loot their items.

Once you've gathered enough items, you'll face a critical decision: establish a stronghold and defend it, or adopt a more aggressive approach by engaging and eliminating your competition.

If you're the last man standing, you can bask in your victory with a great ending. If you and your allies are the only ones left, you have 30 seconds to make a choice. Your rational decisions will determine whether you collectively finish the game with finesse or if there's a lone victor.

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/a5f7ad7a68ec3b46c34b53812adaf77734c2809b.jpg

Mercenaries!

Prepare yourselves for the exciting debut of Last Man Standing Mode, the newest mode mission from AVA Global.

Last Man Standing Mode is a unique survivor mode that promises a thrilling experience for both newcomers and veterans.

Dive into the heart-pounding action reminiscent of your arcade days, where every quarter spent meant hours of non-stop fun with your neighborhood pals.

[previewyoutube=wzP5SwyyA8g;full][/previewyoutube]

Story Overview:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/203b41742e03840a97a593e35149ded7c42f800c.jpg

EU forces have made the decision to transport prisoners from a camp near the city of Petrozavodsk to a camp near St. Petersburg. 
For some reason, EU special operatives have infiltrated the group, disguising themselves as prisoners. As the prisoners attempt to hijack a helicopter, their plan fails, leading them to employ parachutes to escape. 
An unmapped island in the middle of Lake Ladoga in northwestern Russia. The uninhabited town in the middle of nowhere periodically sounds an alarm, each time releasing a deadly cloud of spores from an undisclosed location. 
With a limited number of survival kits, prisoners and special operatives await rescue and begin a desperate fight for survival that teeters between cooperation and betrayal.
