notes.title: Cutomize Your Weapon Skin: Weapon Customization System!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/25b592723f5631e32596a2c48d906974a7499caf.png

Mercenaries!

This September update brings you a whole new system: the Weapon Customization System!

Introducing the Weapon Customization System:

The Weapon Customization System is a brand-new feature that allows players to customize the skins of their weapons. 

Customize your weapon skins to make them your own!

Before diving into Weapon Customization, let's watch the sneak peek of Weapon Effect Customization: AF-90 SAS!

Weapon Effect Customization: AF-90 SAS
[previewyoutube=7yczhtb_IWM;full][/previewyoutube]

How to customize weapons:

There are two main ways to improve your weapons:
1. Record kills and assists in quick match mode to earn EXP.
2. Use the same skin item as a material in the weapon customization menu to gain significant EXP.
Tip: You can now use duplicate/same weapons as a source of EXP, so you can maximize your weapon EXP and Kill and assist Points efficiently!

List of weapons with the Weapon Customization System:

After the September update, the Weapon Customization System will be rolled out for prioritized select weapons.

TC-9 SAS
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/93810baaa84095e1c709a08af2d7a838819bb55f.png

AF-90 SAS
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/51fb865d68364046d07107240264f8203afc9922.png

ML SC5 SAS
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/8c6df556204c2632aa7314c2f77d8c94e92d3761.png

First, all players with the Free Battle Pass will receive 100% access to one Weapon Customization System-enabled skin.

Players who purchase the Paid Battle Pass can access three skins with the Weapon Customization System.

In addition, more released skins will be available from the existing Premium tier skins.
After the September update, two additional new skins will be released, so stay tuned.

How to apply the Weapon Customization Item:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/38da2d1e04929dffcca8dd869ada35d7f4d5c2d4.png
Note: The image is for reference only and may differ from the actual game screen.

1. When you enter the Weapon Customization menu, you'll see the weapon's level information and cosmetic item information.

Selecting each tab will list the corresponding items, and each cosmetic item will be labeled with its name and itemization. Clicking the Buy button for a cosmetic item that you have not yet purchased will make it available to spend points and use for motivation.
Note: Once you click the Buy button, you will not be able to get your points back, so please be careful when purchasing items.

2. Each weapon may have different types of customization items available for purchase. The maximum level varies depending on the types of items that can be purchased.

3. The maximum level depends on the number of Customization Effect Taps each weapon has, from a maximum level of 20 to a maximum of 50.
Users can purchase weapon customization items with the points they receive whenever they level up the weapon.
Players earn 1 point for each level increase, which can be used to purchase items.

4. All customized weapons will be labeled as "MAX" for maximum leveled weapons in your inventory, where you can see your current level and level experience gauge.
Once maxed out, all cosmetic items will be unlocked, and each weapon will have a different number of available cosmetics, as well as a different number of points required.

This is the first new weapon progression system in AVA Global, and we've put a lot of work into it. We hope you enjoy it, and if you have any suggestions, we'll be sure to take them into consideration.

*Please note that the content introduced above may be subject to change due to internal reasons.


Thank you.

Sincerely,
Your AVA Global Operation Team

notes.title: A.V.A Global Dev Letter: August Balance Patch
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/294ba589586bbf47bd884734a6df091974a7d1bb.png

Mercenaries!

First and foremost, we extend our sincere gratitude to you for showing continued support for AVA Global!

We have been diligently analyzing gameplay data to ensure that you have a more enjoyable and immersive experience. Through our analysis, we have identified the need to improve the character and weapon balance.

Considering that these updates are in their early stages, we understand that some players might encounter instances of confusion, awkwardness, or temporary inconvenience.

However, we believe that these changes are necessary to create a more fair and competitive environment for all players. We will continue to monitor the data and make further adjustments as needed.

Our goal is to implement positive changes that will improve the game for everyone. We are committed to making AVA Global the best it can be, and we appreciate your feedback as we move forward.

A.V.A Global development team is constantly brainstorming new ways to improve the game, drawing on the years of experience that players have accumulated.

We've pondered the significance of introducing updates that consistently reshape weapon performance. This introspection led us to seek avenues for elevating the gaming experience to new heights. Today, we're proud to share that after thorough reflection, we've pinpointed a pivotal juncture for change.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/3605107b14f4b9d0973685296d04a0d9b6634d18.png

Our reflections have centered around augmenting the allure of characters, aiming ultimately to establish a captivating synergy between characters and weapons.

In AVA Global, character roles are currently not as strategically significant as we would like. To address this, we are rebalancing the game's structure to better utilize the strategic potential of characters. In the future, we will be moving away from a focus on primary weapons and toward a more strategic mix of characters and items.

Driven by this insight, we're embarking on a journey to introduce a fresh perspective over the medium to long term.

We will introduce new character concepts and balance their performance to ensure that each character has a unique playstyle and that each weapon is viable in different situations. We will continue to balance the game as needed to make sure that it is fair and fun for all players

Furthermore, we are not only balancing the existing weapons, but we are also incorporating future special weapon systems and enhanced traits to bring you a fresh new experience.

We value your enthusiasm and support as we move through this evolution, and we look forward to having you on board.

Sincerely,

A.V.A Global Operations & Dev Team

notes.title: A.V.A Global Death Valley Mode - The Mission Has Gone to Hell!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/66ac039953cc0939e25dd7ab9212423ae71b4c7d.jpg

Mercenaries!

Prepare yourselves for the exciting debut of Death Valley, the newest scenario mission from AVA Global.

Death Valley is a co-op mode that promises a thrilling experience for both newcomers and veterans. 

Dive into the heart-pounding action reminiscent of your arcade days, where every quarter spent meant hours of non-stop fun with your neighborhood pals.

Story Overview:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/f79e62ac09106159ebb4f891ee4b7295a3e89ced.jpg

After the end of the European War in April 2011, the arrests and trials of war criminals from the old NRF were underway. Various plots and schemes that took place under the NRF regime were beginning to come to light.

Pavel, a commander of the NRF's Interior Ministry Special Forces and a suspected war criminal, was allegedly responsible for the Chernivtsi incident. In this incident, NRF soldiers infected with residual chemical weapons leaked from an abandoned NRF biological weapons research facility developed psychotic symptoms and rioted.

EU intelligence agencies tracking Colonel Pavel Panfilov received information that he may have been the leader of the militants who took over the small island of Warbal in the Kai Islands, on the border between Indonesia and Papua New Guinea, two years ago.

Colonel Panfilov, who led the development of a special biochemical weapon that awakened only human ferocity and combat instincts, escaped the NRF after the war with only a handful of his men, along with his research and data. He then traveled to Southeast Asia.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/fe8e89161a26735572040dfeb563d3c952bbc03a.jpg

After capturing the island of Warbal, which he had been eyeing for some time, Colonel Panfilov built a massive facility to smelt underground zinc ore for its byproduct, indium. He used the profits from the smuggling of indium to fortify the island. He then used his research to form a band of pirates, who used their beefed-up soldiers to blockade the surrounding sea lanes and demand exorbitant tolls.

Determined to eliminate the growing threat posed by Colonel Panfilov, EU intelligence planned the disintegration of the group through the elimination of Panfilov, who led the organization with powerful charisma and dictatorship. They sent special forces to do so.

Death Valley Rewards:

Two new rewards, the Death Row Mask and Mad Galil Survivor, will be available in the upcoming update as rewards for playing the Death Valley Mode.

Brace yourself for an added challenge as the August update introduces two escalating difficulty levels, offering enhanced rewards as you brave the tougher settings. Once Death Valley is live, anticipate a series of engaging events designed to help you secure these exclusive items.

[Mad Galil Survivor]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/14fbb32d734c8c6d4e0521cab452d1296c9265cc.png

[Death Row Mask]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/17fe3f2516ccdab2e811e71aab2c7f90b038f0a3.png


Journey Through Each Stage of Death Valley:

Boat: After clearing out the enemies in the cave, you will arrive at the dock and find your boat ready to go. Use the Engine [E] key on the instrument panel to start the boat and it will take off.
Tip: As soon as you start the boat, you will be swarmed by fast prisoners from the back of the boat, so be prepared to react quickly.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/c9941e2052647c5bb488e32761c20cf836c5efaa.png

Bridge section: The moving boat will stop in front of a wooden bridge. To destroy the bridge, you need to remove the explosive drums indicated by the arrows. The bridge must be removed in two stages: first and second.
Tip: Make sure to remove all of the explosive drums before destroying the bridge. This will make it easier to destroy the bridge and avoid taking damage.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/0cc3bc920a4446a43d7083c6aa15bcfc0ae45fcb.png

Tunnel section: You must navigate through the tunnel while avoiding the walls, prisoners, and UAVs attacking from above.
Tip: Use the space on either side of the boat to avoid the UAVs and target enemies. You can also destroy the launchers to prevent the UAVs from spawning.

Gatekeeper: This is the final section of Round 1 and the passage to Round 2. A drum-throwing mob awaits you here, guarding the gate.
Tip: This mob has high health, so use the Health Packs and AmoPacks on the boat to defeat it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/da8536ec0f60066d1606846da4c79efbd38a4d17.png

Lift Section: At the start of Round 2, after clearing out the remnants, players will find a broken passageway. Players will need to use the repeatedly reciprocating lifts to cross the bridge and eliminate the Drum Throwing Mob and a number of Prisoners.
Tip: Enemies on the other side will continue to spawn unless the player crosses the lift, so be aggressive and take them out quickly.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/90619f53a93b10a58492a9a61b7ca4736d02916a.png

Ball Drop: A giant ball-shaped byproduct with a specific pattern will roll toward you, and you will need to avoid it to advance. In the secondary ball drop, two balls will roll in a specific pattern and mobs waiting at the top will block your progress.
Tip: Read the pattern of the balls and use the intervening dodge spots to advance. You can also use grenades to take out the enemies on top.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/e726d01235a153eb5f2f49f93c6a31dedca17495.jpg

Automatic gate section: There are three automatic gates in total, and you will need to eliminate the large amount of enemies waiting for you.
Tip: There are several different types of mobs here, so be prepared to use a variety of weapons and strategies.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/55831d565d4b161d5f842896a70f24068a012e8d.png

Chopper Section: The final boss of Round 2, the Chopper threatens you with its incredible health and missile attacks. You will need to use RPGs scattered around the ground to shoot it down.
Tip: This section requires a bit of teamwork, so work with your teammates to take down the Chopper quickly.

UAV 1: This is the early part of Round 3, where you will need to dodge UAV fire and destroy the multiple UAV launchers set up in front of you.
Tip: It's important to focus on each launch pad rather than spreading out. This will help you take down the UAVs more quickly.

UAV Section 2: Destroy the UAV launchers that open doors at regular intervals and take out multiple mobs. You can only clear this section by destroying all the UAV launchers.
Tip: This is a time-consuming section where teamwork between players is very important. Work together to destroy the launchers quickly and take out the mobs that appear.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/32868964b9cf846bc1e6138db26b405b60c29be3.png

Boss Area: The final boss area gives you a chance to regroup and admire the rainbow waterfall before entering. This is the final section of the Death Valley map where players will need to be vengeful and tough, and it's also the final way out after the boss is defeated.
Tip: There are no special tips, just teamwork, and skill to defeat the boss and eventually escape.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/3605107b14f4b9d0973685296d04a0d9b6634d18.png

We're thrilled to present Death Valley, a mode long-awaited by our community. Your support and enjoyment are invaluable to us as we continue to craft exceptional gaming experiences. Brace yourselves for the thrill of Death Valley – we can't wait for you to immerse yourselves in the action!

*Please note that the content introduced above may be subject to change due to internal reasons.


Thank you.

Sincerely,
Your AVA Global Operation Team

notes.title: 3ON3 Mode: Elite Team Match Play!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/1f5bcd73ef5561f1eee2bb67161826f65e4d9d2f.jpg

Mercenaries!

In the upcoming August update, a fresh and exciting mode, "3ON3," will be open in A.V.A Global.

While our expansive collection of maps has included thrilling 5v5 and 8v8 battles, "3ON3" marks the arrival of a small-scale combat experience, offering a new dimension of engagement.

This mode represents a significant milestone for AVA Global, unveiling the first-ever addition to our array of game modes.

3ON3 Mode:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/5842ab4f3062bcb620d69b1e68779d283fc644c4.jpg

"3ON3" Mode takes advantage of the three distinct classes within AVA Global to create fast-paced, small-scale skirmishes. This mode allows three elite operatives to collaborate and unleash their strategic prowess in a dynamic and frenetic battlefield environment.

A departure from traditional strategic gameplay, "3ON3" Mode demands swift thinking and adaptability, as players must react promptly to evolving circumstances. This mode brings a fresh breeze of competitive action to our gaming landscape.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/dd697ab16938bfd790ba013551424353a8193ed0.jpg

3ON3 Mode Rewards:

We're excited to introduce a unique achievement reward system exclusively for "3ON3" Mode. Players will be rewarded with an A.V.A Box for winning, available with repeated rewards.

Please mark your calendars for our special one-year anniversary update in August, when we'll unveil the Victory Badge achievement reward system. Collect Victory Badges in 3on3 mode to unlock a variety of exciting rewards:

Earn 5 Victory Badges in 3on3 mode to get  Premium Box*1
Earn 25 Victory Badges in 3on3 mode to get Unique Soldier Box*1
Earn 50 Victory Badges in 3on3 mode to get Unique Soldier Box*5
*Please note that Victory Badge rewards are based on your total number of 3on3 mode victory badges earned and can only be claimed once.

3ON3 Mode Rules:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/e55f0d579d47a89bcc3d5c50dd88afd40c44c7be.jpg

In the new 3v3 mode, teams will compete in a series of 19 rounds, with the first team to reach 10 wins being declared the winner. The first round will be a pistol showdown, with each player selecting from one of the three available classes. If a player does not select a class, they can either collaborate with the other players who did not choose or randomly select a class.

If the score is tied at 9-9, the Deuce Rule will come into play. Under the Deuce Rule, the first team to win two consecutive rounds will be declared the winner. The Deuce Rule can only be applied for a maximum of 20 rounds.

We are excited to introduce the 3v3 mode, our first foray into small-scale battles. We believe this mode will offer a unique and challenging experience for our players. We hope you enjoy it!

We value your feedback and will use it to shape the future of the 3v3 mode.

Once again, we appreciate your continued support of AVA Global

*Please note that the content introduced above may be subject to change due to internal reasons.


Thank you.

Sincerely,
Your AVA Global Operation Team

notes.title: A.V.A Global Dev Letter August
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/6813222167f296dcb1f7b901a3e4ea07f04f36bb.png

Mercenaries!

Exciting news, everyone! Get ready for a thrilling new update to our beloved game! Our team has been working tirelessly over the past few months to bring you an even better gameplay experience, packed with thrilling new features and enhanced gameplay.

1 Year Anniversary Greetings

As you're already aware, August 25th holds a special place in our hearts, marking the one-year anniversary of Ava Global. Since our launch last year, we've been tirelessly delivering enriching content, with much more in the pipeline. Our journey thus far has been made possible by your unwavering interest and heartfelt feedback.

The memories of AVA's global debut on that remarkable day still resonate with us, igniting our passion. However, beyond this significant milestone, we're excited to unveil what lies ahead in the coming years!

New Modes: 4-player CO-OP Death Valley & Elite Squad Play 3on3
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/fe8e89161a26735572040dfeb563d3c952bbc03a.jpg

To celebrate our one-year anniversary, we are introducing two new modes: Death Valley and 3on3. Death Valley has been a highly anticipated mode for quite some time now, and we're thrilled to finally be able to bring it to you after meticulous development, ensuring seamless integration into the AVA global experience.

Death Valley places teamwork at its core, promising a captivating and engaging experience. On the other hand, the 3on3 mode is a small-scale combat that offers a thrilling, fast-paced experience, unlike any other modes you've seen in AVA Global before.

Both of these fresh modes come with unique rewards distinct from our existing pocket rewards. Stay tuned for more comprehensive details coming your way next week!

Enhanced Skin Combination System
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/d90a0dc10932641a3a475ff0ca66a4da3e8a05d7.png

We're attentive to your feedback, and in response to the observations made about the skin combination system in the July patch, we're rolling out improvements in the August update. These refinements will expedite the acquisition of exclusive skins, as we persistently strive to enhance your gaming journey.

Furthermore, our commitment extends to other in-game enhancements, such as refining the on/off functionality of in-game effects. Stay tuned for more details in our upcoming announcements.

Sneak Peek: August Update Skin Preview

Recent patches have unveiled exciting new weaponry like the SW.338 and Z3A3, paired with exceptional skins to complement them. The upcoming August update keeps this tradition alive.

As we approach the update, we're delighted to offer a glimpse into the array of new amazing skins awaiting you.

notes.title: NEW MODE: INFILTRATION - FALCON
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/327d47a717e3518d2251bf314b6e5e32e68874f8.png

Mercenaries!

Are you ready for a new experience? 
Today, we are thrilled to unveil Infiltration Mode, a groundbreaking game mode that goes beyond the boundaries of traditional Battle Royale. Prepare yourself for strategic team battles on A.V.A Global's brand-new map - FALCON!

In Infiltration Mode, we're introducing a completely fresh approach to enjoying A.V.A Global, offering you a truly unique and immersive experience.

Mission Overview
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/4fa86e0b7387ff5e61e35855992acc7e9fefa8fd.jpg

Mission Type: Round Operation - Infiltration: Falcon
The U.S. Department of Defense gets informed of militant activity in Alaska by Canada's 401st Aviation Brigade. 

As the NRF departs their camouflaged base in Kakona, the US military realizes that a month had passed since Operation Battle Defense (Brooklyn Bridge). 

They immediately mobilize their forces and evacuate to Bulduer Island, Alaska, along with the remaining EU soldiers.

As soon as the battle begins, EU soldiers must infiltrate the stronghold and hack into one of the control devices at each location to disable the radar. 

Match Info
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/c75fb58bbe3db584e6e0d33519259ef3870fd511.jpg

In Infiltration Mode, players are divided into two teams:
- The NRF forces must stop the EU forces. 

[Winning Conditions] 
- EU: Hack one of the 2 mission objectives or eliminate the NRF forces.
- NRF: Prevent the EU forces from hacking the control unit, or eliminate the EU forces.

Falcon mode only features:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/66ae8581390dd9c5e2a51e84fab5c241fbfef618.jpg

The Infiltration mode introduces various elements, including destructible objects like iron plates, wood, glass, doors, fire extinguishers, and more. These objects can be utilized to change your route and employ disruptive tactics, leading to diverse gameplay experiences.

Additionally, the NRF team will receive several seconds of automatic reconnaissance when they leave the building at the beginning of battles.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/797bdb980d9d3bd25671f009769602bca8762279.jpg

We have created a night version of the mode to enhance the feeling of an Infiltration Operation. By adapting the visuals to match the night setting, we have focused on creating a compelling atmosphere while ensuring optimal visibility.

This mode brings a refreshing change of pace from the traditional Demolition mode, and we encourage you to experiment with different strategies and discover your own must-win strategies.

We hope you enjoy the new Infiltration mode!

*Please note that the content introduced above may be subject to change due to internal reasons.


Thank you.

Sincerely,

Your AVA Global Operation Team

Mercenaries!

Exciting news, everyone! Get ready for a thrilling new update to our beloved game! Our team has been working tirelessly over the past few months to bring you an even better gameplay experience, packed with thrilling new features and enhanced gameplay.

Prepare yourself for a sneak peek at what's to come: a brand-new game mode, breathtaking skins, innovative new systems, and so much more! We can't wait to share all the exciting details with you, so stay tuned for the big reveal.

New Mode: Inflitration
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/0a39de50ae9f8b6862a08ec50ff7d95b1737e31d.png

Get ready for a new game mode that steps beyond traditional Battle. In this mode, the offensive team is an operation to infiltrate the enemy's camp and hack into major facilities, and the defense team aims to prevent it. 
It will give you a new way to enjoy A.V.A Global so get ready for a truly unique experience!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/f6652e1e9f8d117825764e8894d4211c6cb2d48a.jpg

Stay tuned for more details on this exciting new mode before the next patch, and get ready to blow away the competition with the new Infiltration Mode!

New Box System:

At A.V.A Global, we have been introducing special boxes containing unique skins to the in-game store with every update. We have received valuable feedback from many users regarding these box products, and in the upcoming July patch, we are excited to unveil a new type of box that will be available in the in-game store. This new box will feature a hybrid format combining a "package + box" structure.

With the new box, you will have the opportunity to acquire a specific number of limited special boxes, and plus, you will be guaranteed to obtain either a Jackpot skin or a premium tier skin. This ensures that when you open this hybrid box, you will receive at least one of these highly desirable items.

In summary, this new boxed offering will provide you with a unique experience and a 100% chance to win either a Jackpot Skin or a Premium Skin. 
We encourage you to stay tuned for more information regarding this exciting announcement, which will be shared next week.

Launch of the Arena Starter Pack
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/d14c9108200b2891e35d6c19a227c771effe1bc2.png

Arena mode is a ranked game mode where players can showcase their true skills. By participating in this mode, players can earn special rewards. Alongside the ongoing Arena Season 10, the Clan Mark War is also taking place. 

Arena mode is available exclusively to Arena Plus members, who enjoy various rewards and benefits. However, we have taken into consideration the feedback we received from our users regarding Arena membership. In order to encourage more players to participate in Arena while ensuring a guaranteed and fair gaming environment, we will be introducing the Arena Starter Pack. Further details will be announced in the future, but we are designing the packages to be "stackable" with the existing Arena Plus membership benefits, allowing current members to also enjoy the new pack's advantages. We appreciate your continued support and enthusiasm.

Combination System Improvements
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/d90a0dc10932641a3a475ff0ca66a4da3e8a05d7.png
In the June update, Ava Global introduced two exciting additions: the Content Roulette system and the Skin Combination system. We are delighted to see that many users have enjoyed these new features, and we would like to express our sincere appreciation for all the valuable feedback you have provided us.

To further enrich your experience with the new content, we have diligently worked on implementing several enhancements that will be included in the upcoming July patch. These improvements aim to provide you with an even more enjoyable and satisfying gameplay experience.

Stay tuned for more updates and get ready to enjoy all the new content coming your way!

*Please note that the content introduced above may be subject to change due to internal reasons.


Thank you.

Sincerely,

Your AVA Global Operations Team

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/48ec670659976f188934a8b7f4de0920a91617bc.jpg

Mercenaries!

"Skin Combination" is a mechanic of consuming two weapon skins to obtain a new weapon skin.

It is restricted to each group: Pointman, Rifleman, and Sniper.
Two weapons from the same group can be combined, and the weapon of the same group will be obtained through a combination process.
Tiers of weapons that can be used as Combination materials are "Regular," "Epic," and "Premium."

Skin Combination System New Season!
We've made a slight change to the system where you can now obtain combined skins via this system.

Two weapons from the same group can be combined, and a tier higher (or the same) skin is obtained through the combination process.

After the Season 4 update, A.V.A Global Skin Combination System will have a new skin combination process.

The A.V.A Global Skin Combination System has been updated with a new skin combination process. Now, you can combine two weapons from the same group to obtain a tier higher (or the same) skin.

The new skin combination process will be available after the Season 4 update.

Weapons used as materials for Combination will NOT be returned.

However, there are exclusive 9 skins that can only be obtained through Skin Combination.

For example, if you combine two Epic skins, you will receive either an Epic or Premium skin.

notes.title: A.V.A Global Roulette System
notes.content:
Mercenaries!

We are excited to introduce the A.V.A Global Roulette system, a new way to earn AVA Euros. 
This is a brand-new game system that we hope will provide you with more ways to enjoy A.V.A Global.

Roulette Basic Rules:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/7ee0656a5b7a9da638414e6bc61b887b35952c2d.jpg

The Roulette System is a mechanic where you consume EURO to obtain more EURO by setting your goal's roulette choice with how much EURO you put in.


 You can choose to consume 3,000, 6,000, 9,000, 12,000, or 15,000 EURO.
 You can also choose to double your EURO by selecting the x2, x4, x6, x8, or x12 options.
 Once you have made your choices, the roulette wheel will spin and you will win if your choice matches the section that the wheel stops on.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/b48f135138231a31589134a1c501ef73671b93fe.png

What is 'JACKPOT'?
There is a special lucky section called 'JACKPOT' in the slot. 'JACKPOT' is a special slot where users can have a chance to get a huge amount of EURO.


 When you start the Roulette System, the minimum amount you can bet for 'JACKPOT' is 100,000 EURO. 
 The 'JACKPOT' prize amount increases by 2% of the bet amount every time a user loses and does not win the 'JACKPOT'.


Winning the 'JACKPOT'
If you win the 'JACKPOT' slot, you will have a chance to take 'JACKPOT' EURO for a bonus!


 This means that you will have another chance to spin the 'JACKPOT' wheel to take the 'JACKPOT' EURO with the slot (10%, 20%, 30%, 50%, 100%).
 Users can win up to 100 million EURO.

*Please note that everything we are sharing today along with any mentioned information may be subject to change
We hope you enjoy the new A.V.A Global Roulette system. Good luck!

Thank you

A.V.A Global Operation Team

Mercenaries!

We've recently mentioned exciting news - the Clan system. This presents a fantastic opportunity for players from around the globe to create communities and find new friends to play A.V.A Global.

Please note that all the information and timelines we're sharing today are subject to change.

notes.title: Dev Letter - AVA Global Innovation
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/131da23edf3c9644d5754856deb8f3bc6d733aab.jpg

Mercenaries!

We’ve been working hard to improve the gameplay experience of A.V.A Global by adding new content, constantly updating the weapon balance, and many others.

Our work continues today to provide a more enjoyable experience by providing various gunplay options while maintaining realistic gunplay and core fun.

Through this announcement,  we'd like to take this opportunity to give you a sneak peek of what we are preparing in the upcoming update and tell you what's new for the June update.

1. New Season Format
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/c9479dc55264683c6ca2da94cb09218451cb051e.png

Season 4 is being prepared and is scheduled to open after the June update. 
Thank you so much for your interest and participation in Season 3 'CORE'.

For the following Season, our team is preparing a new format to introduce a variety of weapon series. 
Players will get more opportunities to get seasonal skins in Battle Pass and limited skins in the in-game shop boxes.

2. Clan Mark Wars
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/36a4ea8781c202f4c9263dcf29cab5b7e3f05c90.png

As you play, you face moments where you have to make various choices such as choosing your Class, Weapons, Squad, and many others which will significantly impact your match results.

Therefore, we want to diversify the range of options to provide more options to enjoy A.V.A Global.

Strategy plus teamplay is one of the most important points in A.V.A Global as well as the weapon balance. 

So, we conducted new systems to our game experience more enjoyable.
We believed that Clan Mark War system will bring a new era to skill-based users of A.V.A Global.

After the June update, we will continuously improve Clan Mark Wars for future updates and development directions.

3. New Cloud Service - Geforce Now
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/9bfcf566e1464ebe1c25018544d80cf01a9ad65a.jpg

After Season 4 is introduced, A.V.A Global will be available to play on one of most players' favorite devices through GeForce NOW, a cloud-based game streaming service. 

NVIDIA's game streaming service allows games with a GeForce NOW account on a wide variety of systems, to play a wide selection of games without the need to download a game client, or even have a high-end gaming PC.

Sign up for GeForce NOW via the NVIDIA website, and join the fun on A.V.A Global!

4. New Combination System 2.0
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/0c794804c91c1f0fa45ef1e7f4104e68e99e6c1a.png

The "Skin Combination" system is was a new system that was introduced to A.V.A Global for all users who wanted a variety of skins. 
We've made a slight change to the system where you can now obtain combined skins via this system.

Two weapons from the same group can be combined, and a higher tier(or same) is obtained through a combination process.

After the Season 4 update, A.V.A Global Skin Combination System will have a new skin combination process.

The combination-obtainable skins line-up will be released in the near future. So stay tuned!

We hope you are looking forward to the new season update. Make sure to share AVA Global with all of your friends!

We will continue to improve the game and provide a better experience!
*Please note that everything we are sharing today along with any mentioned information may be subject to change

Thank you.

Sincerely,
Your AVA Global Operations Team

notes.title: A.V.A Global New Mode - Dominate The Time !
notes.content:
1. Introducing 'OVERRIDER'
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/d274e457574b9b9a7f34b6cfba3d086ed9764da7.jpg

Story Overview:
Overrider is a new mode in AVA Train that allows players to experience a stylish and challenging shooting experience. In Overrider, players take on the role of two secretly trained special forces soldiers who, after years of research, develop a prototype mask with the ability to slow down time and infiltrate an enemy secret base.

 Trailer: "Dominate The Time"
[previewyoutube=tbnzYwhYZfs;full][/previewyoutube]

What is 'Overrider Skill'?
The Overrider skill is the key to success in Overrider mode. This skill allows players to slow down time, giving them a chance to accurately target enemies and dodge incoming projectiles. The Overrider skill is especially useful when dealing with powerful enemies or when multiple enemies are attacking at once.

You'll most likely use it against faster enemies or when multiple enemies swoop in at the same time, and it can be used to track and dodge fast projectiles like RPGs and missiles.

It's also an essential skill when dealing with powerful bosses (Bellona) in the final round.

NOTE:
*In particular, Overrider skill requires charging after activation.
*It is very important for players to consider the charging time in order to deal with crisis situations.

Round Features:
Three open-field rounds and an arena-style boss round (4R).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/d987b065cdc56593a6749e91d4217168522dd0df.png

ROUND 1 - Electric Sheild
Break through the electric shields of the enemy control center.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/65e9795d213043c5e1d8ce02c4339fe49ac4755e.jpg
In Round 1, players must break through the electric shields of the enemy control center. To do this, players must fend off enemies that swoop in from the open field and make their way inside the control center.

ROUND 2 - Pain Bridge
Make your way over the enemy telecommunications room and escape to the chopper.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/fc1a295f80b6700cd0c7825134fd0114a99d1cdd.jpg
In Round 2, players must cross a broken bridge into the enemy telecommunications room and call for an escape helicopter. This round is more challenging than Round 1, as players must navigate through a variety of traps and fend off enemies that are attacking from both sides of the bridge.

ROUND 3 - Black Lift
Defend against the enemy onslaught.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/f2a2769a2986a6a238fb8cc98e169b1f52b37c2f.jpg
In Round 3, players must defend against an enemy onslaught in a space called the "elevator." This round is the most challenging of the four, as players must fend off different types of enemy attacks in specific locations.

ROUND 4- Bellona
Defeat the final boss, 'Bellona'
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/ca7ad34d5bc9940f5f23cacf696ed0465b9321f0.jpg
In Round 4, players must defeat the final boss, Bellona. Bellona is a powerful enemy that can deal a lot of damage. To defeat Bellona, players can use the Overrider skill to slow down time and accurately target her weak points.

5. Mode Reward

For successfully completing Overrider mode, players will receive a random chance to obtain exclusive rewards. The rewards that players can obtain include exclusive rewards: the ' OverRider Emperor Mask' and 'R.SRH OverRider' in normal level.

OverRider Emperor Mask
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/a29c41e94b1bc6eef17330f5bd872119693c83e2.jpg

R.SRH OverRider
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/d2c93550b1700b22ff3bf292553b0993ee4317a1.jpg

The likelihood of obtaining these limited items will vary based on the difficulty level, meaning that you'll receive them faster and more if you complete the mode on a higher difficulty level.

For a higher difficulty level, you will get a higher random chance to obtain exclusive rewards: the ' OverRider Emperor Mask', R.SRH OverRider', ' R.SRH Storm Rider' and 'Smoke Storm Rider'

[R.SRH Storm Rider]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/3eeed6de6ec55a9a480212f814893a5f08004903.jpg

[Smoke Storm Rider]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/feb0a0c63c1af356c689176ac7e2e0374626aab9.jpg

Cooperative Play
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/1fcc1d7da1c5b9ed32046ce683a104109b42777f.jpg
Overrider mode can also be played in a two-player co-op. In co-op mode, players can use the Overrider skill to help each other overcome crises. This is a key element of Overrider and a cooperative skill that allows players to help each other.

*Please note that the new mode information may be subject to change.

Sincerely,
Your AVA Global Operation Team

notes.title: Skin Combination New Unique Skins Announcement
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/0473b2307bceeeaa4628c81e69ebc324b0cef3f1.png

Mercenaries!

"Skin Combination" is a mechanic of consuming two weapon skins to obtain a new weapon skin.

It is restricted to each group: Pointman, Rifleman, and Sniper.
Two weapons from the same group can be combined, and the weapon of the same group will be obtained through a combination process.

Tiers of weapons that can be used as Combination materials are "Regular," "Epic," and "Premium."

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/0c794804c91c1f0fa45ef1e7f4104e68e99e6c1a.png

If you proceed with the Skin Combination, you will consume a certain amount of Euros.
Weapons used as materials for Combination will NOT be returned.

The tier of the Combination result depends on the tiers of materials. In general, using high-tier skins as materials increase the probability of high-tier results.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/7c6ad49d312a959cce88b3ae956f34b554312a91.png

Exclusive Unique Skin Update - From Skin Combination, general Unique tier skins cannot be obtained.

However, there are exclusive Unique skins that can only be obtained through Skin Combination.

Try to obtain these rare Unique skins through Skin Combination.

Skin Combination Skin List Update
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/154b8cb22d918921689d00f57f69baaa96d84194.png
*Please note that items that become unobtainable as a result of skin combinations can still be used as materials.

notes.title: [A.V.A Train Event] Rise to the TOP 5 Challengers!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/7c843458d88efc04b47a6554cdee26e2b4ca615d.png

Mercenaries!

A.V.A Train Mode began with an 'Easy Mode' option after the April patch. 

A.V.A Train Mode offers a thrilling experience with diverse AI bosses, stages filled with numerous items, and unique enemies scattered across the train.

While many players have found it enjoyable, we understand that some players may have found the mode challenging, regardless of their skill level.

We have heard feedback from players who feel intimidated or worried about the difficulty level is too high, and we want to ensure that all players have the opportunity to enjoy A.V.A Train Mode.

To help players get accustomed to A.V.A Train Mode, we have decided to extend the 'Easy Mode' schedule. This will give users more time to familiarize themselves with the gameplay and mechanics and have fun exploring the train and facing off against enemies.

[A.V.A Train mode schedule]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/58ef7af4415edd6776e2d6f08ae13c669928a754.jpg

Not only do we want to make the mode difficulty as accessible as possible but also want to give more fun to users who have already cleared the 'Easy Mode' level.

Therefore, we're introducing a special mission challenge event for A.V.A Train Mode. 
Starting from April 24, you'll have three days to participate in Mission Challenges and compete for a chance to earn '870 Inspire Skin' by becoming one of the TOP 5 players with the most kill counts or Top 5 lowest death counts during the event schedule.

[870 Inspire]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/ac9ca964a6b65020ad25426bf92cd529fe443975.png

*'870 Inspire' is an exclusive reward only available in A.V.A Train hard mode, so don't miss out on this fantastic opportunity to get your hands on this unique reward early!

[Event Discription]
Become one of the TOP 5 players with the most kill counts in A.V.A Train Mode between 
2023. 04. 24 09: 00 AM ~ 2023. 04. 26 14:59 PM(UTC)

Become one of the TOP 5 players with the fewest deaths in A.V.A Train Mode between 
2023. 04. 24 09: 00 AM ~ 2023. 04. 26 14:59 PM(UTC)

[Event Reward]
-  '870 Inspire' skin *1

NOTE
-You need to play A.V.A Train mode every day(3 days) during the event schedule
- To participate in the event, players need to play full A.V.A Train Mode matches during the event schedule. Disconnecting the match does not count toward playtime.
- The match is counted when you finish the match from the Start. Staying in the lobby does not count toward playtime.
- Rewards will be sent within 3 business days after the event finishes.
- You must play at least 5 mins in a match to be successfully counted.
- During gameplay, the number of kills and the minimum number of deaths are tracked for each team as a whole, rather than for individual players.

We hope you have fun!

Sincerely,

Your AVA Global Operations Team

notes.title: Sci-Fi Arms: Future Weapons
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/0e51a90316d3a1b0b370d6bc03abf405d3a27521.jpg

Mercenaries!

Today, we're excited to share how our team brought the Sci-Fi skins to life in A.V.A Global.
Sci-Fi skins will take over AVA Global after the April Patch.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/531b9c66adc3e186d6b44f00c351c5bbc0c32767.png

Sci-Fi skins Design
The Sci-Fi series skins are the result of collaboration with renowned weapons designer Andrew Meissner, and we wanted to create a unique and visually appealing experience for our players while maintaining the competitive integrity of the weapons and working within performance constraints.

To achieve this, we experimented with an interesting combination of some light tech and 2D painted textures to create special effects like the blue light effect. 

[Desmodus Sci-Fi]
[previewyoutube=AmdrGnq9bFY;full][/previewyoutube]

These custom materials, such as the captivating blue light effect, add a level of visual interest to our skins, making them truly stand out in A.V.A Global.

We also decided to incorporate a 'Sci-Fi' effect flowing inside the material to tie in with the larger Sci-Fi set and make it visually stunning.

[EPKO Sci-Fi]
[previewyoutube=YpsEFuTW-SQ;full][/previewyoutube]

For the 'Sci-Fi' Technician of Light skins, we aimed to represent the main concept of Sci-Fi by incorporating powerful techniques into the skins that could help players fight off weapons running wild in A.V.A Global.

Beautiful & Powerful Design
We also aimed to craft a formidable yet beautiful aesthetic in our skins.

Developing these fresh and exciting skins involves behind-the-scenes work that may not always be visible, but it's always rewarding when we can create new content that enhances the experience of A.V.A Global's weapon skins.

[Zebra Sci-Fi]
[previewyoutube=hSj6ywX9nR4;full][/previewyoutube]

We hope this has provided you with deeper insights into our new skins, and hope you enjoyed gaining a deeper understanding of our creative process.

You can check the full skin video in the below content
[previewyoutube=Jmkg-kw9GGQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Where you can find it: In-game shop > Featured > Recommended or All.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/88b96966e769a0c3f79c0283680b0d07e0f920fb.png

Thank you for your continued support, and stay tuned for more exciting updates from our team!"

Thank you.

Sincerely
A.V.A Global Operation Team

notes.title: A.V.A Global Train Mode - It's Time To Move Forward!
notes.content:
1. Introducing 'AVA Train'

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/b29a730926c60165cba133f54710cc155bd13e72.jpg

Story Overview:
- During Erdmann's sinister experiments, he kept a group of villains and test subjects confined in his secret train with the intention of using them to spread a deadly infection and create a new empire. 

In response, a joint operation was launched by the EU and NRF to put an end to his dangerous schemes. Unfortunately, during the process, all of the individuals perished, with only two survivors left.

- These 2 survivors are the last hope to save humanity.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/86f228c366581edb790393a5d7231490639e60df.jpg

Key Features of 'AVA Train'

 A PvE progressive scenario mode with five chapters and over 30 train cars in total.
 Features all AIs that have appeared in AVA Global so far (Villain All-Stars & Chapter Bosses).
AI with unique attack patterns and powerful enemies to encounter across different stages.
 Upgrade option of ATK/HP through a growth system (enhancing both co-op and role-playing elements)
 Utilization of special weapons to overcome crisis situations and take on bosses (providing an exhilarating experience of firepower).
 Co-op play with friends through two-player mode.


3. AVA Train Schedule

Following the April 20 patch, we will be introducing A.V.A Train mode on Easy difficulty to help you get started.

Once you're comfortable with the gameplay, the normal difficulty will be available on Monday, April 24, and will continue through Thursday.

Please note that the difficulty level may be adjusted after that.

To ensure the best experience, we suggest that players become familiar with the content before April 20, as a more challenging difficulty may be unlocked at that time.

[AVA Train Schedule]
Easy Mode: (UTC) 2023. 04. 20 (after April Patch) ~ 2023. 04. 24 07:00 AM
Normal Mode: (UTC) 2023. 04. 24 07:00 AM ~ 2023. 04. 27 07:00 AM

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/6e9063f33c9606a11f00f5ee03fe168f8a66a6cb.jpg

4. Gameplay & Rewards

Chapter 1: Escape from the prison cell and confront new guards along with the deadly 'Combat Enhancer Type B+' on the train.
Chapter 2: Engage in an intense combat against the 'Enhanced Infection Host' aboard the train.
Chapter 3: Explore a variety of action/puzzle play and the battle against the 'Evolved Battle Gear Legion'.
Chapter 4: Fight with evolved slash techniques on an open train and face off against 'Clone Panfilov 2'.
Chapter 5: Engage in the final showdown against the train's ultimate boss, 'Erdmann I Consummate'."

5. Mode Reward

For successfully completing the mode, you'll get a random chance to obtain exclusive rewards: the 'Erdman Mask' and 'Red Erdman Mask.'

The likelihood of obtaining these limited items will vary based on the difficulty level, meaning that you'll receive them faster if you complete the mode on a higher difficulty level.

We've introduced the "AI Life" respawn item to help make the new mode more manageable. So, feel free to give it a try!

notes.title: New Demolition Mode - Free2Bomb Mode
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/63b7898ae5ab5ca70de140549269d4ad49a21f8a.jpg

Mercenaries!

As the Level Designer for AVA Global, I'm thrilled to announce the release of our latest game mode, Free2Bomb.

Put your C4 on the Front Line!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/7521ade4a1faf933b91b0ceade7235b5f653683d.jpg

In Free2Bomb, we've taken the classic Demolition mode and added an exciting twist to create a fresh and unique experience. The mode closely follows the same rules as traditional Demolition, but with a core battle area that revolves around biological and chemical bombs (C4-F2B).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/8d64fe84f4592d64441f4405fedf856d7116c25e.png

The EU can acquire and place these bombs anywhere, allowing for more strategic gameplay as you choose the engagement area after installing the bomb. Unlike traditional Demolition mode, the location where the EU installs the C4-F2B becomes the core engagement area.

Mode Tips - C4 could be Anywhere

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/c20e5c5a522c5b34cb9cf36ceb4c356ea6ef9bb7.jpg

We've selected India, Junkyard, and Silo as the initial service levels for F2B. The installation area balance for Demolition mission levels favors the NRF defense by default, so it may be better to capture the C4-F2B in the front and engage in the battle in a more favorable area.

Fun Part - Installing C4 in a creative way

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/abde23a16673b9bf9065ff66aabdefa9da955e46.jpg

But the most enjoyable part of Free2Bomb is setting up C4-F2B in unexpected places and defending them. This brings a fun change of pace from traditional Demolition mode, and we encourage you to experiment with different setups and find your own must-win strategies.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/1765ecfbeb0c59194b91a4ba9a7bcca1c26c370b.jpg

We appreciate our AVA Global users' love of Demolition Mission, and we've been working hard to make it even more enjoyable. Free2Bomb is the culmination of one of our ideas, and we'll continue to work hard to make Avatar even more exciting.

Thank you for playing, and we hope you enjoy the new Free2Bomb mode!

*Please note that the content introduced above may be subject to change due to internal reasons.


Thank you.

Sincerely,

Your AVA Global Level Designer

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/e5577065fbdd29c12475e9441e603d7b31d734f4.png

Mercenaries!

Exciting news, everyone! Get ready for a thrilling new update to our beloved game! Our team has been working tirelessly over the past few months to bring you an even better gameplay experience, packed with thrilling new features and enhanced gameplay.

Prepare yourself for a sneak peek at what's to come: a brand-new game mode, breathtaking skins, innovative gameplay systems, and so much more! We can't wait to share all the exciting details with you, so stay tuned for the big reveal.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/96c912e2821a2ff8128aebd4d85e5f41d4eac353.png

New Mode: Free2Bomb

Get ready for a fresh take on your favorite bombing missions with the all-new Free2Bomb mode!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/63b7898ae5ab5ca70de140549269d4ad49a21f8a.jpg

Get ready to shake up your bombing strategy with our thrilling new game mode, F2B! This exciting mode brings a fresh twist to traditional bombing missions by introducing biological munitions (C4-F2B) that EU teams can acquire from existing installation areas and place anywhere they want.

But that's not all - the core engagement area has also been revamped, making F2B vastly different from the traditional Demolition mode. With new challenges and strategies to explore, F2B promises to keep you on the edge of your seat with every mission.

Stay tuned for more details on this exciting new mode before the next update, and get ready to blow away the competition with your new F2B skills!


Spray System:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/639d7f6ac242f3057dda7661ad1c42e106e8bc54.png

Looking for a new way to have fun in-game?
Say hello to the Spray System!

We are introducing this brand-new feature to AVA Global for the first time.
This new system will provide you with scalable content in-game, that will add even more fun to your gameplay.

Try using this Spray System to send different messages to your teammates and opponents.
We'll be adding more items to the system in future updates, and you can expect to see the "Duck" and "Caiman" in the upcoming March update.

Get ready to spray and play!

New Season, New Changes

>Battle Pass: Season 3 'Core'

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/c9479dc55264683c6ca2da94cb09218451cb051e.png

As winter draws to a close, so does Season 2 - Bloody Bark. We want to take a moment to express our gratitude to all our fans who supported us during this epic season. Your enthusiasm and dedication have made it a resounding success.

But don't fret, because we've got even bigger things in store for Season 3 - Core, which will kick off with our upcoming update. And to sweeten the deal, the Season 3 Battle Pass will unlock the exclusive "CORE" seasonal skin, guaranteed to make your enemies tremble with fear.

And that's not all - we've also got an exciting lineup of other skins in store for you, so keep your eyes peeled for updates on what's to come. Get ready to level up and dominate the competition in Season 3 - Core!



>ARENA Rework

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/fd5804873dcfc61f28c7e2b66c260e1f2f8d8031.png

Get ready for an all-new ARENA Season format as we gear up for Season 4! We're excited to introduce a revamped structure that will provide a more cohesive and engaging experience for players.

And that's not all - after the conclusion of Arena Season 3, we'll be launching Arena Season 4 with the next update, so get ready to dive back in for another round of intense competition.

The new format will feature shorter durations but still offer rich rewards, so get ready to compete like never before and climb the ranks to become the ultimate champion. Stay tuned for more details on what's to come in the next exciting season of ARENA!


> Game Usability Fixes:

As we transition into a new season, we've made some improvements to the game's usability.

The winter lobby will be replaced with a new "Spring" concept lobby to coincide with the change of seasons.

Additionally, the In-Game Store categories have been revamped as well to make it easier for users to find and purchase skins.

Look out for new "Spring" skins as part of the In-Game Store overhaul!

As we head into the new season, we're working on various things to bring you more content and fun in AVA Global.

Stay tuned for more updates and get ready to enjoy all the new content coming your way!

*Please note that the content introduced above may be subject to change due to internal reasons.


Thank you.

Sincerely,

Your AVA Global Operations Team

notes.title: Hide & Seek Mode!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/d16972197cf264d477ae02d102173e0faa877c8e.png

Mercenaries!

Through this February Patch, sniper annihilation mode will be closed, and the "Hide & Seek" mode will be newly added to A.V.A Global to welcome you. 

Hide & Seek mode allows you to experience a new play experience of being chased and seeking, not a battle play method like the existing modes. 

Hide & Seek Mode
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/7f90ec04e98cd162fb6007a0052c833b6cee35a7.png

The rules are simple: one team becomes the Taggers, and the other becomes the Objects.
If you are in the Object Team, you will select one of the three objects and transform into that object.
Once you turn into the object of your choice, you must hide in the appropriate location before the game starts.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/19f5515d1a12080b28390f17f4a73267564aa94f.png

Each object player can remove previously placed objects up to three times per round.
Utilizing this feature effectively will help you win the game against the taggers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/1c97877eafa69d9c2cbaf1f279e79422efe22dd1.jpg

When the game starts, the Tagger Team has to find the Object Team hidden all over the map.

After a certain period of time, the surviving Object Team will undergo a second transformation randomly.
At this point, players need to react quickly to the changed situation.

In the final phase. the tagger team will launch indiscriminate attacks. 
Find the perfect place to hide and stay focused until the end to avoid enemy attacks!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/4f2ef098c119024428ccc99d5dea061ad447e192.png

If you are a Tagger, shoot down the suspicious objects and eliminate all the enemies hiding around you!
However, If you shoot at a regular object instead of the object team, you will lose HP.
Since you will be sent out of the game if you lose all your HP, it is best to refrain from shooting objects randomly.

Carefully scan the terrain to spot the object team hiding!

MAPS
This Hide & Seek mode will be played on the 'Showdown, Slim Fox, Barricade, Breakout, and E-Boat maps.

notes.title: A.V.A Global Dev Letter - 2023 Febuary
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/99412c0181919b1056552682a48004f73b68d3eb.png

Dear Mercenaries,

Greetings!

I am the AVA Global Balancing Designer, and I am excited to introduce myself to you for the first time through this Developer Letter. 

It is my pleasure to be able to provide you with details regarding the upcoming balance patches for several weapons in the game.

First of all, here’s a little background on why we’re rebalancing weapons.

One of the most prominent features of AVA is the Three-Class System: Pointman, Rifleman, and Sniper.

Despite the Rifleman being intended as the centerpiece of the three classes, it is played less by users compared to the other classes.

Additionally, the other weapons belonging to the Rifleman class, apart from the MA-47, are not meeting their intended roles as expected.

To address this current issue, we have made balance adjustments for X4A1 and X36.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/73b030de0fa1c4337aab0cb1b536996b04e7b5f9.png

-     Reduced ATK damage variance

-     Increased range and Rate of Fire

-     Significantly increased DPS

X4A1 is one of the users’ favorite weapons for its high rate of fire and accuracy.

These changes will make up for its relatively weak ATK damage compared to other weapons and provide users with greater satisfaction.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/78c3f02be6b0c9a05504281ab13ab7d9db997562.png

-     Increased ATK and Rate of Fire

-     Modified recoil pattern for easier gun operation

X36 is a mid-range combat weapon with high accuracy, but it has a recoil problem.

We have modified the recoil pattern to make it easier for users to operate.
Our Development Team always strives to improve the quality of the game based on your feedback.

Our utmost priority is to ensure a fun and engaging gaming experience while upholding game balance, and we remain committed to achieving this goal.

Thank you.

Sincerely,
AVA Global Balancing Designer

notes.title: A.V.A Global January Patch Note
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/b9249d62e256de53df2c89bcb1e4b2c142e3d70b.png

Mercenaries!

The Patch Notes for the January patch are finally here!

This patch contains various features, such as a new mode, content, and new skins that will be revealed gradually.

The skins that will be added immediately following this update are attractive too, but we will also open additional limited skins for Valentine's Day soon, so please stay tuned!

New Mode: Infection Mode

Map: Burning Temple, Dark Chamber, Dual Site, Prison Break

As the first update in 2023, we have added a new mode - Infection - to provide gamers with a more diverse gameplay experience.

[previewyoutube=wM0Je0WbJSc;full][/previewyoutube]

When you play Infection, you will encounter a whole new enemy that you have never met in A.V.A Global before.

This will provide an exciting gaming experience and a completely new gaming style.

"Infection" is a mode in which one of the players becomes an infected monster and tries to infect all the humans.

The "infected" will win if they successfully infect all the humans, and the humans will win if they defeat all the infected monsters.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/e754b5024c6ff666d01f923a4738d48b7f3babec.jpg

You will be able to enjoy "villain play" more in this A.V.A Global Infection mode since we have reinforced the creature features of the "infectious agents," allowing you to feel a little more superior when playing.

The infectious agents are classified into "Spore Host" and "Bubble Host."

The "Spore Host" carries one spore that can be used to attack and damage the enemy, and the "Bubble Host" carries 10 bubbles that can temporarily pause the enemy's movements.

The infectious agents have a little more HP, and although the genus has been slightly enhanced, there are no additional advantages.

Spore damage deducts 3 HP per second and lasts over 10 seconds to deduct 30 HP in total.

However, you can only have one spoiler, so try to use it effectively as your final weapon; otherwise, you will fall into a more challenging situation.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/05334c4fb31547c2b5ae566b33a44ed1ba4ad059.jpg

In "Infection," the screen has been darkened to allow users to become more immersed in the gameplay.

Due to the darkened vision, the players will be able to feel the tension, and the infectious agent will be unable to find them easily.

Since the repeated gameplay on a fixed map can be tedious, we added cabinet objects to create more hiding space for humans.

If humans hide in the cabinets, each infectious agent will have to spend more time looking for the hiding humans; this adds to the thrills of the game by allowing the humans to overcome their fear and survive until the end of the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/7fc131c96cc5780a23bb48d4165c8c357493d3a0.jpg

As a reward for this new mode, a "Cursed Box" will be added, which you can receive along with the Premium Box & AVA Box.

The method of receiving the rewards is the same as in the Demolition.

The process for receiving rewards is the same as it is in the standard Demolition mode.

There is also a special item reward that can only be obtained in the “Cursed Box” of “Infection,” so please participate.

New Mode Rewards: Cursed Box, Premium Box, A.V.A Box obtainable

Cursed Box Jackpot Item: 

Red Slasher
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/1a049ae7677376387fa18d978e1c6281ac0ba4c1.png

Jason Chainsaw
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/e4ed0f65c96aa08a1421533d64df472b467f3848.png

Infector Slasher
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/227c45b68c88f04999aa6ba1e25d53db148a0a9b.png


New Content: Skin Combination

The "Skin Combination" system is a feature we are introducing to you for the first time; it is A.V.A Global's new trial and a brand-new game system you have not seen before.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/fb7f01645477be9964249a5f0799a03adf6d3f84.png

This fascinating content will broaden your in-game play experiences.

Since the Skin Combination system is being introduced for the first time, we hope many users will try it out. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/0c794804c91c1f0fa45ef1e7f4104e68e99e6c1a.png

We will continue to improve the system’s completeness through continuous patches in the future.

Skin Combination is restricted to each group: Pointman, Rifleman, Sniper.
Two weapons from the same group can be combined, and the weapon of the same group will be obtained through a combination process.

Exclusive Skin Combination Skins:

Bahamut Blue Valkyrie
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/73452ed5045ab8fce0453dfe4095175439048973.png

MA-47 Mammon
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/818406f35a2e516c022c0cb46ed24cced3e34e35.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/1a08d5e22c597f67ce0553f3c051c235885db9d0.png

From Skin Combination, general Unique tier skins cannot be obtained.

However, there are exclusive Unique skins that can only be obtained through Skin Combination.
Skin Combination Jackpot Skins: Bahamut Blue Valkyrie, MA-47 Mammon, SR-F2 Gold Horse

The Exclusive Unique Skins will be added for the first time after the patch, and we have prepared one skin for each weapon class.

The list will expand through future patches, so please stay tuned!

Demolition - Map Changes

Staccato Open & Showdown Close
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/f518f4d7ea9c20acabb2370f8bce6cea115a6843.jpg

Game System Updates
The following significant change this patch is bringing is the opening of the "South American" Server.
We plan to open a new server in this patch to improve the gameplay environment for South American users.
Through this enhancement, A.V.A Global will be accessible to a broader range of users, resulting in a more stable and enjoyable gaming environment.

Balance Update

First, Armour Piercing will be altered for M1903, X24, and Silver Arrow, and the ATK and Range of M1903 will be adjusted in accordance with the balance work.

Silver Arrow and X24's close-range One-Shot Kill chances will be increased to make the game more user-friendly.

While preserving the unique elements of A.V.A Global, we'll keep giving users additional opportunities to enjoy using a variety of weapons and providing realistic and varied gameplay experiences.

Ultimately, this Balance Patch aims to provide more engaging shooting play experiences by maximizing the diversity of weapon choices and making the game more enjoyable.

notes.title: SKIN COMBINATION SYSTEM Announcement
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/69936808b9e8b33a2ffdd70d816d4eaa039bc2fe.jpg

Mercenaries!

The "Skin Combination" system is a feature we are introducing to you for the first time; it is A.V.A Global's new trial and a brand-new game system you have not seen before.

This is fascinating content that will broaden your in-game play experiences.

Now, let's take this opportunity to learn about the Skin Combination system!

Skin Combination Basie Rules:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/0c794804c91c1f0fa45ef1e7f4104e68e99e6c1a.png

"Skin Combination" is a mechanic of consuming two weapon skins to obtain a new weapon skin.

If you proceed with the Skin Combination, you will consume a certain amount of Euros.
Weapons used as materials for Combination will NOT be returned.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/8419d6c2ff365016df24bba1004eee646b150ad0.png

Skin Combination is restricted to each group: Pointman, Rifleman, Sniper.
Two weapons from the same group can be combined, and the weapon of the same group will be obtained through a combination process.

Tiers of weapons that can be used as Combination materials are "Regular," "Epic," and "Premium."

The tier of the Combination result depends on the tiers of materials. In general, using high-tier skins as materials increases the probability of high-tier results.


Exclusive Unique Skin - From Skin Combination, general Unique tier skins cannot be obtained.

However, there are exclusive Unique skins that can only be obtained through Skin Combination.

Try to obtain these rare Unique skins through Skin Combination.

*Note:
-Items that CAN NOT be used as materials for Skin Combination are as follows:
>Items that are not of "Regular," "Epic," or "Premium" tiers.
>Items that are in the 'Unique' tier.
>Items that are the new base weapon(MA-47M & WCX-SBR) skins.
>Currently equipped items.
>Items on Favorites.

Exclusive Unique skins can be obtained by combining the weapons from the same groups.
Pointman skin can only be obtained by combining two Pointman skins.

Skin Combination Exclusive Skins:

Typical Unique tier skins cannot be acquired in the Skin Combination system.

However, exclusive Unique tier skins can only be obtained through the Skin Combination process.

Exclusive Unique tier Skin List:

- Bahamut Blue Valkyrie
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/73452ed5045ab8fce0453dfe4095175439048973.png

- MA-47 Mammon
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/818406f35a2e516c022c0cb46ed24cced3e34e35.png

- SR-F2 Gold Horse
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/1a08d5e22c597f67ce0553f3c051c235885db9d0.png

The Exclusive Unique Skins will be added for the first time after the patch, and we have prepared one skin for each weapon class.

The list will expand in future patches, so please stay tuned!

Thank you

A.V.A Global Operation Team

notes.content:

Mercenaries!

We are very excited to present to you the first developer letter of 2023.
Through this letter, we would like to introduce you to the major patch that will be made next week. 

This patch is full of amazing news, including a new mode, new content, and more!

*"This Dev letter does not include all of the content of the patch; you can discover additional information about the patch in the patch notes that will be issued later."



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/e754b5024c6ff666d01f923a4738d48b7f3babec.jpg

As the first patch in 2023, we have added a new mode - Infection Mode - to provide gamers with a more diverse gameplay experience. 

In this new "Infection" mode, you will face a whole new enemy that you have never met in A.V.A Global before. This will provide you with an intensive gaming experience as well as a completely new gameplay style.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/7fc131c96cc5780a23bb48d4165c8c357493d3a0.jpg

"Infection" is a mode in which one of the players becomes an infected monster and tries to infect all the humans. The infected can win if they successfully infect all the humans, and the humans can win if they defeat all the infected monsters.

Please look forward to this new mode, as it is a specially reworked "Infection Mode," only for A.V.A global!



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/0c794804c91c1f0fa45ef1e7f4104e68e99e6c1a.png

We'd like to introduce you to the Skin Combination System for the first time, a new endeavor by A.V.A Global that will be implemented via a patch next week!

This content is an entirely new in-game system you have not seen before, and we are confident that it will provide you with a wider variety of gameplay experiences.

Shooting is the most crucial part of playing A.V.A Global, as it is the core content and a vital element of the game.

Therefore, we strive to provide users with the most choices and opportunities to offer them the most diversified shooting experiences possible.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/8419d6c2ff365016df24bba1004eee646b150ad0.png

The new Skin Combination system will provide users with an entirely new experience, allowing them to utilize less-used or redundant skins to obtain new skins efficiently.



The following significant change this patch is bringing is the opening of the "South American" Server.

We plan to open a new server in this patch to improve the gameplay environment for South American users.

Through this enhancement, A.V.A Global will be accessible to a broader range of users, resulting in a more stable and enjoyable gaming environment.



[M1903]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/5e0cafcdc1d31f2090e4ccf9983597eeb75e9444.png

A.V.A Global has added several modes so far, and elements like map changes/additions and varied classes allow users to experience weapon balance in different ways.

We are continuously thinking about balancing weapons to give users a better overall shooting experience, which is A.V.A Global's core content.

Following the last weapon balancing, another significant balancing patch will also be made this time.

[Silver Arrow]

notes.content:
Mercenaries! 

After careful consideration, the December update will bring you exciting content!
*Please note that everything we are sharing today along with any mentioned information may be subject to change

New Mode: Infinity Domination
Map: Crash Point
In particular, in the upcoming December update, we plan to release a PVE & PVP hybrid mode, known as "Infinite Domination" after the December update.
[previewyoutube=SySlBmKRXIQ;full][/previewyoutube]

In Infinite Domination, mercenaries have to capture and occupy a site to win the round. Your team engineers fix the computers which fill the site occupancy.
Each mercenary has 5 life points from the beginning of the match but will lose a life point after death or if failed to occupy the site.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/809626a58ed1fe71c70ca6e2ce3e5c607d88482d.png

Mercenaries can overcome these challenges by picking up items such as grenade launchers and more.
On this battlefield, you get to opportunity to obtain the 'Rosewell' skin series which is only obtainable in this mode. There are various tiers in the 'Roswell' skins, do your best to collect them all.

Lastly, you can obtain a very special drop reward from this mode that'll add more fun to the gameplay.
Roswell Backpack, Roswell Box, and Roswell Chest will drop when eliminating the in-game mid-bosses.

notes.title: What to expect in the December Update
notes.content:
Mercenaries!

Before the December Update begins, we would like to welcome you to the last skin update of the year.

In this update, we have a series of Bloody Bark skins, mysterious Roswell skins, and many others!
The various skins are to be released in Season 2. These skins will be obtainable through a new mode, and the in-game shop!
Make sure not to miss this opportunity and celebrate the end of the year with the new skins!

Infinity Domination - Roswell Skin Series

In Infinity Domination, mercenaries must capture and occupy a site to win the round. Your team technicians fix the computers which fill the site occupancy.
Each mercenary has 5 life points from the beginning of the match but will lose a life point after death or if failed to occupy the site.

As the match progresses, it becomes more and more challenging as stronger AI enemies spawn.
Mercenaries can overcome these challenges by picking up items such as grenade launchers and more.
On this battlefield, you get the opportunity to obtain the 'Roswell skin,' which is only obtainable through this mode. There are various tiers in the 'Roswell' skins, so try your best to collect them all.

You can obtain a very special drop reward from this mode that'll add more fun to the gameplay.
Green Treasure Box, Blue Treasure Box, and Red Treasure Box will drop once the in-game mid-bosses are eliminated.
Drop rewards allow you to receive Roswell series skin items with a certain probability.

notes.title: INFINITY DOMINATION Announcement
notes.content:
Mercenaries!

After the launch in August 2022, A.V.A Global is preparing for the SEASON 2 Update.
Thank you for your support and encouragement since the official launch of A.V.A Global.
With the SEASON 2 Update, A.V.A Global's unique and special mode 'Infinity Domination' will be added.

Since it's the new mode you can find only in A.V.A Global, you'll be able to experience new types of strategies and excitement.

Without further delay, let us introduce 'Infinity Domination.' to you.
*Please note that everything we are sharing today along with any mentioned information may be subject to change
[previewyoutube=SySlBmKRXIQ;full][/previewyoutube]

A.V.A Global Infinity Domination:
1. Game rule:
> Players are engaged in a battle over occupied territory and after the territory is occupied, all users are rotated to the next map.
>There is no fixed end to the game, and the player will have five lives. If he or she dies or the opponent takes over the territory five times, the user is sent to the lobby. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/066a46d9c986d03faa75e03d3cd8c84ab77683a2.png

2. Domination:
> The Domination time is set differently for each map considering its features and sizes.
> Only AI Engineers can take over the territory which increases the domination status icon.
> The team with more Engineers has the advantage when occupying the territory.
> However, players do not have the option to occupy the territory by themselves.
> Domination Neutral: The domination status icon becomes “neutral” when the number of both teams AI Engineers is the same.
> When the domination becomes neutral, the domination gauge gets deducted slowly back to the initial state.
> When neutral, securing the objective (when dominated by friendly forces) / resetting the objective (when dominated by the enemy) is possible.
> Calculation for the number of people securing/resetting the objective: Player 0.5, AI Engineer 1 point each.
If the number of people is the same, then the domination gauge slowly moves toward the team that entered last.
> When the objective is dominated, players respawn in the next map after the transition scene that plays for about 8 seconds.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/8a3bc729724eb257201b4620ae34bb00a01b7e80.png

3. Mode Appearance AI
>There are a total of six types of AI bots: "Engineers, Guards, Medics, and hidden mid-boss AI"
>The AI's basic attack power is lower than other players, but if the opposing team takes over the territory twice in a row, the AI's attack power will continuously increase from the third round, until winning, which will reset the attack power.
>AI respawn will be balanced depending on the number of players.
