notes.title: BLOODY BARK SEASON 2 ROADMAP
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/81e3bb42f685a03c95c29de5c5a2293ba3f4be29.jpg

Mercenaries!

First of all, we would like to thank everyone for their continuous support from the launch to Season 1.
We'd like to take this opportunity to give you a sneak peek of what we are preparing in the upcoming update and tell you what's new for Season 2.

New Hybrid Mode
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/6ae0a23120827b7665ac0112627b1ad5332fee88.jpg

In particular, in the upcoming December update we are planning to release a PVE & PVP hybrid mode, which is known as "Infinite Domination" and after the December update,
we are considering adding additional modes during Season 2.

However, due to the current environment, there are parts that need to be systematically optimized.
We would appreciate your understanding that the modes cannot be added immediately.

In Infinite Domination, mercenaries have to capture and occupy a site to win the round. Your team engineers fix the computers which fill the site occupancy.
Each mercenary has 5 life points from the beginning of the match but will lose a life point after death or if failed to occupy the site.

As the match progresses, it becomes more and more challenging as stronger enemies spawn.
Mercenaries can overcome these challenges by picking up items such as grenade launchers and more.
On this battlefield, you get to opportunity to obtain the 'Rosewell' which is only given in this more. There are various tiers in the 'Rosewell' skins, do your best to get them all.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/40eb3d2116046c4b333a5113a08d86e8864fb80e.jpg

Community Safety Upgrade and Arena Improvements
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/d14c9108200b2891e35d6c19a227c771effe1bc2.png

We understand community safety is an utmost concern that many mercenaries have voiced their opinions about, especially about the Arena Beta seasons.

We hear you LOUD and CLEAR! In addition to the existing anti-cheat, we will introduce additional effective countermeasures against those who violate the Code of Conduct and End User License Agreement (EULA).
We take community safety VERY seriously; there is no forgiveness for those who ruin the gameplay experience of others.
And, we will do our best to create a safer game environment for ARENA Official Season.

New Valiant Membership
To curb indiscriminate participation in botting and illegal program usage, the Valiant Membership will be introduced for exclusive club members to participate in Arena.

The benefits of Arena participation and ranking will be improved at the same time. This membership will also bring you member dedicated rewards.

Also, we will partially include items to the Valiant Membership reward which is included in last season's Unique Soldier Box.

Battle Pass Season 2
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/c9479dc55264683c6ca2da94cb09218451cb051e.png

As Battle Pass season 1 has concluded, Season 2 is being prepared and will open shortly. Thank you so much for your interest and participation in Season 1.

After the first attempt of Battle Pass, our team has been working diligently to bring you a more complete battle pass.

We are focusing on improving rewards and extending the Battle Pass Levels. Also, there will be missions in the battle pass for extra exp!

Item Balancing
Our team has been listening to your feedback regarding the Item balancing. This will be introduced. 
We have been paying attention to them throughout the various social platforms. We will go into more detail about this in the upcoming patch notes.

We will continue to listen to your suggestions and feedback. We hope you are looking forward to the December update. Make sure to share AVA Global with all of your friends! 

We will continue to improve the game and provide a better experience!

Thank you.

Sincerely,
Your AVA Global Operations Team

notes.content:
Mercenaries! 

Run! Jump! Rush!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/15ff5b58c962567d2ed874779637aea90260f41d.jpg

AVA Global sports mode is almost here! This mode will consist of several challenges: super jump, skipping, shooting, rush, and triathlon.

[previewyoutube=hGJU7jURCg4;full][/previewyoutube]
Sports Mode Schedule

 Time (UTC): 2022. 11. 22, 06: 00 AM ~ 2022. 11. 30, 06:00 AM

Sports Mode Challenges
1. Super Jump
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/48867bef657ce79015aec7639c10c34c702b82ed.jpg

Mercenaries will jump onto platforms to reach a door! Mercenaries score points each time the door is opened. 

2. Skipping!
Mercenaries will jump across a platform with a moving laser without triggering it. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/c95a2f4fa3e5964e50658c919a8c6c342fd493f6.jpg

3. Shooting!
Mercenaries score points by shooting at targets. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/245d75d57f0e1768b622a8c827d9c0e97e612c97.jpg

4. Rush
This challenge consists of 2 rounds where the attacker team rush towards an objective; the defender team prevents the attacker team from reaching the objective. After each round, the teams switch sides. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/7685b373e9cae6f0706b7499cb8f6eef43b809a4.jpg

5. Triathlon (C4, Ball, Board) - Work together and WIN!
C4
This challenge consists of 2 teams defusing a C4 bomb. Some team members are responsible for defusing the C4, but others will be responsible for protecting the defusers. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/c7ac49da8f3499f9e8daecb722590927d1e5ea18.jpg

Ball
A pistol will be provided to mercenaries to defend themselves against incoming balls and pistols. Daring mercenaries might enter the room of their opponent to take eliminate them. 

Board
Mercenaries will score points by turning over the scorecard on the board. The number of scoreboards is dependent on whether you win or lose in the sections. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/05401deb63bb1b61807efbdc277214eb54c03c0e.jpg

Good luck, Mercenaries! 

Sincerely,
Your AVA Global Operations Team

notes.title: ARENA MODE IS READY!
notes.content:
Mercenaries!

Arena Mode is a new game mode that will be added to 'A.V.A Global' in the upcoming October update.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/d14c9108200b2891e35d6c19a227c771effe1bc2.png
As the arena mode will be opened for the first time through this update, the arena season will be held in the form of 'BETA SEASON' for the first & second seasons.

Arena mode is a high concentrating intense mode that is quite different than any other mode. And this mode is focused on the users' skills.
We have to state that everything we are sharing today along with any mentioned timelines may be subject to change.

ARENA Season Date:
ARENA BETA SEASON 1: 14th Oct. 2022 00: 00(UTC) ~ 4th Nov. 2022 00: 00(UTC)
ARENA BETA SEASON 2: 11th Nov. 2022 00: 00(UTC) ~ 2nd Dec. 2022 00: 00(UTC)

ARENA RULE:
The seasons are short however, it will not affect the Arena rewards users will receive.

First of all, until the official Season, users with the rank of 'Staff Sergeant lvl 1' or higher can participate.
*Don't worry. We will hold an experience boost event for users who have not yet achieved the class.

The Arena Match will be held with 10 participants in a 5v5 match. The team that has 7 Wins out of 13 Rounds wins the game.

In Arena mode, you must participate more carefully since friendly fire is applied.

Finally, the Arena Match is a team match that can accommodate up to 10 players, so if you escape from a game that has already started playing, your ranking points will be deducted immediately.
Therefore, users who participate in the match hope to fight together until the end of the match to win and achieve a higher rank.

ARENA Ranking:
Arena season rankings can earn ranking points according to users' play, and if you win an arena match, you can earn ranking points, and if you lose, ranking points will be deducted.
However, as we are hosting the beta season for the first time, we will set a "novice safety section" for users
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/8e1f7c042cedc1ce98bf65d5fdfdfea03afbb9b6.png
*You can check the ARENA RANKING from the 'RANKING' ICON.

So users with 1400 points or less, the ranking points will not be deducted even if they lose the game.
* Users with 1401 points or higher will be deducted from their RP in case of defeat, but will not be lower than 1401 points.

At the start of the Arena season, all users have 1200 base ranking points, and if they have not participated in ARENA for 10 days at the time of the last change in RP,
5 points per day are deducted up to 1200 points of RP, and users with an RP of 1500 or less are not deducted.

ARENA Map:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/d93eb97a7aee1f69493cf4793a4d6cc648a1aa5e.png

Arena Rewards:
As we mentioned in the last post, we plan to provide this arena reward in as many forms as possible.
As long as you participate in ARENA BETA Season 1, users can receive a 'Unique Soldier Box' as an Arena Mode participation reward.
*If you participate the ARENA MODE 50 matches, you will get one Unique Soldier Box.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/37566c7599b64e625ff46af82dee9807530dc3be.png

In addition, users who rank 1st to 100th in the season will receive Arena Season Limited 'HG21C Sand' Skin Reward.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/cc5a22337d9d6e056c9153c53d7f1f9aa3df0f8a.png
Arena Personal Rating Rewards can be received on a rank point basis that you earn every season, and if you earn a higher tier, you can receive a better reward.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/54d694aed8f24ad2240a055e0dc3a4b487dc0607.jpg
Arena mode is a new mode being added, if you take your time and play this mode, you will definitely have fun playing it!

We will continue to add additional features in Arena Mode through future updates.

Please enjoy it!

Sincerely,

Your AVA Global Operations Team

notes.title: [Dev Letter]: What we are preparing
notes.content:
Mercenaries!

First of all, we want to say thank you for your support. The player's fun, and feedback motivated us to keep moving forward.
We feel truly grateful and will continue to take in your feedback and improve 'A.V.A Global'.

In this Dev Letter, we’re going to tell you the current anti-cheat status and upcoming plans for it.

CURRENT ANTI-CHEAT STATUS
As you’ve heard by now, anti-cheat is always a critical priority with Free-to-Play incoming, the need for an effective anti-cheat system is more important than ever.
In the meantime, we are aware of these problems, for more accurate and efficient measures, user play patterns have been accumulated, and mass sanctions were carried out by strengthening the EAC system. Analyzing user play data, and strong efforts will continue in the future.

WHAT IS TO BE STRENGTHENED?
Collecting cheaters’ information and dishing out the bans have been essential things we’ve been doing for some time now.
And we have always tried all the ways to find an efficient way to keep the A.V.A Global community safe.

To help solve these issues, we decide to strengthen the anti-cheat system to the next level.
We are going to strengthen the anti-cheat system this week for a faster and stronger response.

This week's update will be carried out to create a more pleasant game environment through stricter detection methods and strengthening live-time sanctions functions, and many others.

Currently, we are preparing to update the new content for all of the users.
However, before that, it is important for users to enjoy the game in a pleasant and comfortable environment,
So please keep an eye on our official channels for info on when the new features will be ready for you to get into.

Thank you

Sincerely,
A.V.A Global operation team

notes.title: Anti-Cheat Dev Letter
notes.content:
Mercenaries!

Anti-cheat is our major and critical priority. This Dev Letter will go through and talk about what we've been preparing, and how we plan to execute the anti-cheat, as well as what we have planned for the future.

1. In-game report
Automatically detected through our system, cheaters are continuously being banned.
However, mercenaries can help ban the cheaters by using the 'Report Cheater' button on the left-hand bottom when you press the 'ESC' button.
This also helps us verify cheaters more easily!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/17ca9311c8f71c62f9c503fb4882c23cc8405c97.png
However, some cheaters need to be analyzed, so please understand the occasional delay.
This system is to be improved over time.

2. Data accumulation
We accumulate all user-play data on our system to discern cheaters.
The automatic system analysis/detection is based on user play patterns.
This system is continuously being developed and will give us an advantage for verifying cheaters.

3. EOS(EAC) 
EOS (EAC) partial reinforcement and several logs are being analyzed to enhance the functional role of the anti-cheat.

4. Another way we find cheaters
As a lot of people know, A.V.A has been a service for a long time in many versions, 
we have a lot of know-how to determine cheaters. 
After we have more data that has been accumulated, another method of verifying cheaters will be possible.

We have been working diligently to provide all players with an equitable gameplay environment. Many of those who violated the Code of Conduct have received serious consequences; we have already received inquiries from those who violated the Code of Conduct. We do not tolerate any forms of unjustified behavior. Bans will continue to be carried out on a daily basis. 

We will continue to listen and take action to ensure a fair and safe gameplay environment.

Thank you.

Sincerely,
Your AVA Operations Team

notes.title: Differences Between Camp and Clan
notes.content:
Mercenaries!

We have received a lot of questions about the differences between Camps and Clans
so here is some info on the differences between the two.

Camps

 Once you enter a Camp, you may not leave the camp until you have joined a clan.
 Camps are public and users within the camp will be able to talk to each other.
 Playing as a squad in a camp, the camp does not receive 'Clan RP'.
 You may join a camp without approval.


Clans

 Once you enter a Clan, you automatically leave the camp.
 Clans have 'Clan master' and 'Staff' who manage the Clan.
 Clans may receive 'Clan RP' when playing.
 Joining a Clan will need the 'Clan master' or 'Staff' approval.
 Clan emblems (badge) are managed by the 'Clan master'.


We hope this info helps!

Thank you.

Sincerely,
Your AVA Operations Team

notes.title: AVA Global Code of Conduct
notes.content:
Code of Conduct
We ask everyone to practice good human decency and respect for other players.


Responsibility
You are responsible for how you interact within Alliance of Valiant Arms Global (A.V.A Global / AVA). Neowiz and its agents can not be held responsible for actions or comments made be users anywhere. Noewiz reservers the rights to take action upon any content published by a user.

Communication
You are responsible for how you may express yourself. Rude, offensive, and inappropriate means of communication shall not be used. Discrimination, threats, sharing personal information, hate speech, misrepresentation of individuals or entities, racism are unacceptable.

Account Security
You are responsible for the safety of your Steam account. A.V.A Global staff members will never ask for your security credentials.

Cheating
Cheating will result in action taken. Using third party programs, macro, glitches, modification to software or hardware that provides an unfair advantage, exchange of kills/score/win exchange (farming), account sharing or trading, clan sharing or trading, improper gameplay that affects other players are considered as cheating.

A.V.A staff members reserve the rights to determine what constitutes as cheating. This means that action will be taken without notice at staff member's discretion.

Naming
You may not use any names (including clan names) that may represents staff members. This includes, but not limited to: CM, GM, GS, MOD, Staff, Neowiz, or similar variations.

Names (including clan names) must be used must be free from hate speech, cheat promotion, lewd comments, personal information, and account security breach.

Report

Thank you all for your cooperation!

You are responsible for how you interact within Alliance of Valiant Arms (A.V.A). Neowiz and its agents can not be held responsible for actions or comments made be users anywhere. Noewiz reservers the rights to take action upon any content published by a user.

notes.title: A letter from the A.V.A team(3)
notes.content:
Mercenaries!

After our partner streams, we've had a lot of users ask about the Weapon Modification Ticket system.

So, we will like to give you more information about how the Weapon Modification system works.

To request a modification for your weapon, you must have an item called the Weapon Mod Request Ticket.

When used, the modification points are randomly distributed within 5 points according to the designated modification category of each gun.

This improves the performance of the weapon: Attack(damage), Range, Firing Rate, Accuracy, Reload Speed, Recoil Control, Shot Amount (pellets of Shotguns), Mobility, Swap Speed (Sniper), and/or Aim Speed (Sniper).

Pressing the up arrow next to your weapon allows you to use 1 ticket.

Firearm Mod Request Tickets can be purchased through Euros or Medals through the shop. If you need more tickets you can also obtain them through random boxes that are given out at the end of every match.

The gun modification system is a way for you to customize the performance of your own firearm to fit your gameplay style.

If you press the modification icon and press modify, then you will lose the previous stats that have been applied to your weapon – this cannot be reverted back.

Please note that this is not a system that affects the balance of the game.

[Weapon Modification Request Q&A]
Q. How many times can I use Firearm Mod Request?
A. You will be able to use the Firearm Mod Request infinite times but, you will need tickets.

Q. Will the modification points be accumulated every time I use the Firearm Mod Request tickets?
A. No. Firearm Mod Request will only let you gain 5 random points on your weapon. If you use the ticket on your weapon that has already been modified, the weapon will be modified again giving it different stats.

You can check how many tickets you have in your inventory > equipment. 
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/195b1bedd56e27cacb2ec4c16e4b64a42c6fc934.png

[Weapon Modification Tutorial]
In your inventory, press the arrow shape displayed on the left side of the weapon.
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/9a38b1393c220dbeff03390ac1efe2b704fa54c8.png

If you press the arrow shape, then this screen will appear. You can modify the item by pressing “Modify.”
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/7579d7d2d5f3e4f9881d1308969751ab53532571.png

Points will be distributed after weapon modification.
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/e6f1ea3f6117675f318bbf8f7071907052fc613a.png

Improved figures for each stat area are displayed in green.
For example: The Range point blow shows 79.0 as the result of your weapon modification, NOT 79+8.
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39411000/1ebe7404a818d47141d4c57a6676d7d42b9f4601.png
* The images above are examples for understanding purposes. The values applied to each item varies.

We hope this guide is informative!

Thank you.

Sincerely,
Your AVA Operations Team
